title_en: FedARC: Anchor-Guided Residual Compensation for Data and Model Heterogeneous Federated Learning
title_zh: FedARC：用于数据与模型异质联邦学习的锚点引导残差补偿

sentences.en: Federated learning (FL) allows clients to collaboratively train models without exposing private data, but practical FL is simultaneously challenged by data heterogeneity and model heterogeneity.
sentences.zh: 联邦学习（FL）允许客户端在不暴露私有数据的情况下协作训练模型，但实际 FL 同时面临数据异构性与模型异构性的挑战。

sentences.en: Prior heterogeneous FL (HtFL) approaches often fail to handle fine-grained feature shifts, leading to weak representation alignment and limited cross-client knowledge transfer, which degrades both personalization and generalization.
sentences.zh: 先前的异构 FL（HtFL)方法往往无法处理细粒度的特征偏移，导致表示对齐薄弱与跨客户端知识迁移有限，从而损害了个性化与泛化。

sentences.en: We propose FedARC, an HtFL framework that couples a shared lightweight extractor with client-specific fusion: a trainable projector integrates local and global embeddings, while adaptive residual compensation dynamically corrects feature-level mismatches.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 FedARC，一个 HtFL 框架，它将共享的轻量级提取器与客户端特定的融合相结合：一个可训练的投影器整合局部与全局嵌入，而自适应残差补偿动态纠正特征级不匹配。

sentences.en: To further stabilize aggregation, FedARC performs semantic anchor alignment across clients, and we theoretically prove FedARC converges with a non-convex convergence rate $\mathcal{O}(1/T)$.
sentences.zh: 为进一步稳定聚合，FedARC 在各客户端之间执行语义锚对齐，并且我们从理论上证明 FedARC 以 $\mathcal{O}(1/T)$ 的非凸收敛速率收敛。

sentences.en: Experiments on five public benchmarks show that FedARC outperforms nine state-of-the-art HtFL baselines by up to 2.63\% in average accuracy, while maintaining efficient communication and computation.
sentences.zh: 在五个公开基准上的实验表明，FedARC 在平均准确率上比九个最先进的 HtFL 基线高出多达 2.63\%，同时保持高效的通信与计算。

title_en: FedCDWA: Decoupled Federated Prototype Distillation with Hierarchical Wasserstein Aggregation
title_zh: FedCDWA：结合分层 Wasserstein 聚合的解耦联邦原型蒸馏

sentences.en: Federated learning enables decentralized clients to collaboratively train models without sharing local data.
sentences.zh: 联邦学习使去中心化的客户端能够在共享本地数据的情况下协作训练模型。

sentences.en: However, heterogeneous client distributions often induce client drift and hinder convergence.
sentences.zh: 然而，异构的客户端分布往往会引发客户端漂移并阻碍收敛。

sentences.en: This paper proposes FedCDWA, a decoupled hierarchical federated distillation framework.
sentences.zh: 本文提出 FedCDWA，一个解耦的分层联邦蒸馏框架。

sentences.en: FedCDWA decouples client-side personalized distillation from server-side mutual distillation to mitigate distillation-induced optimization conflicts.
sentences.zh: FedCDWA 将客户端端的个性化蒸馏与服务端的相互蒸馏相解耦，以缓解蒸馏引起的优化冲突。

sentences.en: It further adopts Hierarchical Wasserstein Aggregation to aggregate prototypes without restrictive parametric assumptions while preserving intra-class structure and inter-class geometry.
sentences.zh: 它还采用分层 Wasserstein 聚合来聚合原型，无需严格的参数假设，同时保持类内结构与类间几何。

sentences.en: To achieve finer-grained feature alignment, Prototype–Variance Dual Alignment matches feature means and variances in the feature space.
sentences.zh: 为实现更细粒度的特征对齐，原型-方差双对齐在特征空间中匹配特征均值与方差。

sentences.en: We prove convergence guarantees for FedCDWA.
sentences.zh: 我们为 FedCDWA 证明了收敛保证。

sentences.en: Experiments on three datasets demonstrate that FedCDWA consistently improves both global and personalized accuracy across heterogeneity levels, with smaller performance degradation under more severe heterogeneity.
sentences.zh: 在三个数据集上的实验表明，FedCDWA 在各个异构程度上都持续提升全局与个性化准确率，并且在异构性更严重时性能下降更小。

title_en: FedEBA+: Towards Fair and Effective Federated Learning via Entropy-Based Model
title_zh: FedEBA+：通过基于熵的模型迈向公平且有效的联邦学习

sentences.en: Federated Learning (FL) often suffers from sacrificing global model accuracy when improving client-level fairness due to data heterogeneity, which often leads to inconsistent performance of the globally trained models, resulting in unfair outcomes among users.
sentences.zh: 联邦学习（FL）在因数据异构性而提升客户端级公平性时，往往以牺牲全局模型精度为代价，这常常导致全局训练模型的表现不一致，进而在用户之间造成不公平的结果。

sentences.en: Existing fair FL algorithms face a bottleneck: they either sacrifice global model accuracy to promote fairness or fall short of achieving optimal fairness.
sentences.zh: 现有的公平 FL 算法面临一个瓶颈：要么牺牲全局模型精度来促进公平性，要么无法达到最优的公平性。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose a novel framework that effectively improves fairness while preserving global accuracy by integrating information-theoretic principles with model alignment.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出一个新框架，通过将信息论原理与模型对齐相结合，在保持全局精度的同时有效提升公平性。

sentences.en: Specifically, we leverage the Maximum Entropy Principle to derive an analytic, closed-form solution for fair aggregation weights, ensuring significant fairness enhancements.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们利用最大熵原理推导出公平聚合权重的解析式闭式解，确保获得显著的公平性提升。

sentences.en: We further employ a step-wise model alignment strategy that synchronizes gradient directions across heterogeneous clients, effectively mitigating the drift induced by local updates.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步采用逐步式模型对齐策略，同步异构客户端之间的梯度方向，有效缓解局部更新所引入的漂移。

sentences.en: Theoretical analysis proves that our method guarantees convergence even in non-convex settings.
sentences.zh: 理论分析证明，即使在不凸的设定中，我们的方法也能保证收敛。

sentences.en: Importantly, we push the theoretical frontier of federated fairness by extending performance variance analysis to generalized regression, providing broader guarantees.
sentences.zh: 重要的是，我们通过将性能方差分析扩展到广义回归，推进了联邦公平性的理论前沿，提供了更广泛的保证。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on five datasets demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving superior fairness without sacrificing global accuracy.
sentences.zh: 在五个数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法持续优于最先进的方法，在不牺牲全局精度的情况下实现了优越的公平性。

sentences.en: Our code is available at \href{https://github.com/T-Lab-CUHKSZ/FedEBA-Plus}{https://github.com/T-Lab-CUHKSZ/FedEBA-Plus}.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 \href{https://github.com/T-Lab-CUHKSZ/FedEBA-Plus}{https://github.com/T-Lab-CUHKSZ/FedEBA-Plus} 获取。

title_en: FedEMoE: Improving Personalization on Heterogeneous Federated Learning via Elastic Mixture of Experts Architecture
title_zh: FedEMoE：通过弹性混合专家架构改善异质联邦学习的个性化

sentences.en: Heterogeneous federated learning (HtFL) has emerged as a promising approach to address heterogeneity in local computational resources and data distribution.
sentences.zh: 异构联邦学习（HtFL）已成为应对本地计算资源与数据分布异构性的一种有前景的方法。

sentences.en: However, existing methods cause performance degradation of model personalization because personalized and generalized knowledge are either intertwined or dominated by one of them.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法会导致模型个性化性能下降，因为个性化知识与通用知识要么相互纠缠，要么被其中之一所主导。

sentences.en: To address this issue, we propose a novel Elastic Mixture of Experts (EMoE) architecture on HtFL, namely FedEMoE, decoupling personalization from generalization.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出一种在 HtFL 上的新颖弹性混合专家（EMoE）架构，即 FedEMoE，将个性化与泛化解耦。

sentences.en: Specially, FedEMoE employs a multi-scale feature extraction mechanism via personalized experts to enrich personalized knowledge.
sentences.zh: 特别地，FedEMoE 通过个性化专家采用多尺度特征提取机制，以丰富个性化知识。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we design an elastic shared expert to break the transferred knowledge bottleneck across heterogeneous client models.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们设计一个弹性共享专家，以打破跨异构客户端模型的知识迁移瓶颈。

sentences.en: The elastic shared expert can adaptively expand or shrink according to the status of each expert by the weight spectrum analysis, respectively.
sentences.zh: 弹性共享专家能够分别根据权重谱分析，依据每个专家的状态自适应地扩展或收缩。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across statistical and model heterogeneity settings demonstrate that FedEMoE significantly outperforms state-of-the art methods on the accuracy of each heterogeneous model over diverse datasets.
sentences.zh: 在统计与模型异构设定下的大量实验表明，FedEMoE 在各种数据集上显著优于最先进方法对各异构模型的准确率表现。

title_en: Federated Bilevel Performative Prediction
title_zh: 联邦双层施为性预测

sentences.en: Federated bilevel optimization is widely used for nested learning problems across distributed clients, such as federated hyperparameter tuning and meta-learning under privacy and communication constraints.
sentences.zh: 联邦双层优化被广泛用于跨分布式客户端的嵌套学习问题，例如联邦超参数调优，以及在隐私与通信约束下的元学习。

sentences.en: Most existing formulations assume fixed client data distributions, which can be violated by performativity, where deployed decisions reshape client behavior and data collection, inducing client-specific, decision-dependent distribution shift.
sentences.zh: 现有的大多数公式都假设客户端数据分布固定，而这可能会因执行式行为（performativity）而遭到破坏——其中部署的决策会重塑客户端行为与数据采集，引发客户端特定、与决策相关的分布偏移。

sentences.en: We study federated bilevel performative prediction, where both upper-level (UL) and lower-level (LL) objectives are evaluated under client-dependent, decision-dependent distributions.
sentences.zh: 我们研究联邦双层执行式预测，其中上层（UL）与下层（LL）目标都在与客户端相关、与决策相关的分布下进行求值。

sentences.en: We formalize the federated bilevel performatively stable (FBPS) point under a decoupled-risk perspective and provide sufficient conditions for its existence and uniqueness.
sentences.zh: 我们在解耦风险视角下将联邦双层执行式稳定（FBPS）点加以形式化，并为其存在性与唯一性提供充分条件。

sentences.en: We then develop two federated methods to compute the FBPS solution: FBi-RRM, which converges linearly under a contraction condition, and FBi-SGD, a communication-efficient stochastic method based on federated hypergradient estimation with convergence guarantees under diminishing step sizes when sensitivities are sufficiently small.
sentences.zh: 随后我们开发两种联邦方法来计算 FBPS 解：FBi-RRM，它在收缩条件下线性收敛；以及 FBi-SGD，一种基于联邦超梯度估计的通信高效随机方法，当灵敏度足够小时，在递减步长下具有收敛保证。

sentences.en: Experiments on strategic regression and meta strategic classification validate the predicted stability thresholds and demonstrate improved meta-generalization over non-performative baselines, and CNN-based classification further demonstrates the practical effectiveness of the proposed methods in nonconvex neural network settings.
sentences.zh: 在战略回归与元战略分类上的实验验证了预测的稳定性阈值，并展示了相较非执行式基线提升的元泛化性能，而基于 CNN 的分类进一步证明了所提出方法在非凸神经网络设定中的实际有效性。

title_en: Federated Causal Inference on Multi-Site Observational Data via Propensity Score Aggregation
title_zh: 通过倾向得分聚合对多站点观测数据进行联邦因果推断

sentences.en: Causal inference typically assumes centralized access to individual-level data.
sentences.zh: 因果推断通常假设能够集中访问个体层面的数据。

sentences.en: Yet, in practice, data are often decentralized across multiple sites, making centralization infeasible due to privacy, logistical, or legal constraints.
sentences.zh: 然而在实践中，数据往往分散在多个中心，由于隐私、物流或法律约束，集中化并不可行。

sentences.en: We address this problem by estimating the Average Treatment Effect (ATE) from decentralized observational data via a Federated Learning (FL) approach, allowing inference through the exchange of aggregate statistics rather than individual-level data.
sentences.zh: 我们通过联邦学习（FL）方法从分散的观测数据中估计平均处理效应（ATE），从而允许通过交换聚合统计量而非个体层面数据进行推断。

sentences.en: We propose a novel method to estimate propensity scores via a federated weighted average of local scores using Membership Weights (MW), defined as probabilities of site membership conditional on covariates.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一种新方法，使用隶属权重（MW）通过联邦加权平均的本地得分来估计倾向得分，MW 定义为以协变量为条件的站点隶属概率。

sentences.en: MW can be flexibly estimated with parametric or non-parametric classification models using standard FL algorithms.
sentences.zh: MW 可以灵活地使用参数化或非参数化分类模型，结合标准 FL 算法进行估计。

sentences.en: The resulting propensity scores are used to construct Federated Inverse Propensity Weighting (Fed-IPW) and Augmented IPW (Fed-AIPW) estimators.
sentences.zh: 所得的倾向得分用于构建联邦逆倾向加权（Fed-IPW）与增广 IPW（Fed-AIPW）估计器。

sentences.en: In contrast to meta-analysis methods, which fail when any site violates positivity, our approach exploits heterogeneity in treatment assignment across sites to improve overlap.
sentences.zh: 与在任一站点违反积极性时就会失败的元分析方法不同，我们的方法利用跨站点处理分配的异质性来改善重叠。

sentences.en: We show that Fed-IPW and Fed-AIPW perform well under site-level heterogeneity in sample sizes, treatment mechanisms, and covariate distributions.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，Fed-IPW 与 Fed-AIPW 在样本量、处理机制与协变量分布存在站点级异质性时都表现良好。

sentences.en: Theoretical analysis and experiments on simulated and real-world data demonstrate clear advantages over meta-analysis and related approaches.
sentences.zh: 理论分析与在仿真及真实数据上的实验都表明，它们相较于元分析及相关方法具有明显优势。

title_en: Federated Data and Feature Selection by Generalized CUR Decomposition
title_zh: 通过广义 CUR 分解进行联邦数据与特征选择

sentences.en: With the advance of federated learning (FL) in privacy-sensitive domains, the need for efficient and robust training becomes increasingly urgent.
sentences.zh: 随着联邦学习（FL）在隐私敏感领域中的推进，对高效而稳健训练的需求变得日益迫切。

sentences.en: Communication bottlenecks, heterogeneous client distributions, and fairness requirements make it essential to select the “right” data and features for model training.
sentences.zh: 通信瓶颈、异构客户端分布与公平性要求，使得为模型训练选择“正确”的数据与特征变得至关重要。

sentences.en: Yet existing FL research often addresses feature selection and data selection separately, ignoring their interplay in real-world high-dimensional and noisy datasets, leading to suboptimal performance.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有 FL 研究往往分别处理特征选择与数据选择，忽视它们在现实世界高维与含噪数据集中的相互作用，导致性能次优。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose a unified framework for data and feature selection by formulating the problem as a generalized CUR decomposition problem.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们通过将问题形式化为广义 CUR 分解问题，提出一个统一的数据与特征选择框架。

sentences.en: We introduce FedGCUR, a practical framework that integrates a federated column-pivoted QR (FedCPQR) decomposition routine with per-silo row selection.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 FedGCUR，一个集成联邦列主元 QR（FedCPQR）分解程序与各数据孤岛行选择的实用框架。

sentences.en: We prove that FedCPQR produces exactly the same decomposition results as centralized CPQR and establish an upper bound of the reconstruction error of FedGCUR.
sentences.zh: 我们证明 FedCPQR 产生的分解结果与集中式 CPQR 完全一致，并为 FedGCUR 的重建误差建立上界。

sentences.en: Experiments on tabular tasks and vision benchmarks show strong downstream accuracy and absolute CUR reconstruction quality compared with representative data and feature selection baselines.
sentences.zh: 在表格任务与视觉基准上的实验表明，与代表性的数据与特征选择基线相比，我们的方法在下游准确率与绝对 CUR 重建质量上都具有强劲表现。

authors.institution: Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics

title_en: Federated Distillation for Whole Slide Image via Gaussian-Mixture Feature Alignment and Curriculum Integration
title_zh: 通过高斯混合特征对齐与课程整合实现全切片图像联邦蒸馏

sentences.en: Federated learning (FL) offers a promising framework for collaborative digital pathology by enabling model training across institutions.
sentences.zh: 联邦学习（FL）通过支持跨机构的模型训练，为协作数字病理学提供了一种有前景的框架。

sentences.en: However, real-world deployments face heterogeneity arising from diverse multiple instance learning (MIL) architectures and heterogeneous feature extractors across institutions.
sentences.zh: 然而，现实世界部署面临因跨机构多种实例学习（MIL）架构不同与特征提取器异构而产生的异构性。

sentences.en: We propose FedHD, a novel FL framework that performs local Gaussian-mixture feature alignment tailored for WSI analysis.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 FedHD，一个新颖的 FL 框架，针对 WSI 分析执行局部高斯混合特征对齐。

sentences.en: Instead of exchanging model parameters, each client independently distills semantically rich synthetic feature representations aligned with the distribution of real WSIs.
sentences.zh: 每个客户端不交换模型参数，而是独立蒸馏出与真实 WSI 分布对齐的、语义丰富的合成特征表示。

sentences.en: To preserve diagnostic diversity, FedHD adopts a one-to-one distillation strategy, generating a synthetic counterpart for each real slide to avoid over-compression.
sentences.zh: 为保持诊断多样性，FedHD 采用一对一蒸馏策略，为每张真实切片生成一个合成对应物，以避免过度压缩。

sentences.en: During federation, a curriculum-based integration strategy progressively incorporates cross-site synthetic features into local training once performance plateaus.
sentences.zh: 在联邦过程中，当性能趋于平稳时，一种基于课程式的集成策略逐步将跨站点合成特征纳入本地训练。

sentences.en: Furthermore, an optional interpretation module reconstructs pseudo-patches from synthetic embeddings, enhancing transparency.
sentences.zh: 此外，一个可选的解释模块从合成嵌入重建伪补丁，增强透明度。

sentences.en: FedHD is architecture-agnostic, privacy-preserving, and supports personalized yet collaborative training across diverse institutions.
sentences.zh: FedHD 与架构无关、保护隐私，并支持跨不同机构的个性化且协作的训练。

sentences.en: Experiments on TCGA-IDH, CAMELYON16, and CAMELYON17 show that FedHD consistently outperforms state-of-the-art federated and distillation baselines.
sentences.zh: 在 TCGA-IDH、CAMELYON16 与 CAMELYON17 上的实验表明，FedHD 持续优于最先进的联邦与蒸馏基线。

title_en: Federated Graph Learning via Structure-Aware Fusion Using a Kalman Framework with Learnable Dynamics
title_zh: 利用具有可学习动态的 Kalman 框架进行结构感知融合，实现联邦图学习

sentences.en: Federated Graph Learning (FGL) enables collaborative training across distributed clients without sharing raw graph data.
sentences.zh: 联邦图学习（FGL）支持在不共享原始图数据的情况下跨分布式客户端进行协作训练。

sentences.en: However, its performance is severely hindered by graph-specific heterogeneity arising from divergent node feature distributions and disparate graph structures.
sentences.zh: 然而，其性能受到由节点特征分布分歧与图结构差异所引发的图特定异构性的严重阻碍。

sentences.en: Existing FGL methods primarily focus on aligning or personalizing node features but largely overlook the role of structural knowledge, leading to aggregation-induced representation drift during message passing.
sentences.zh: 现有 FGL 方法主要聚焦于对齐或个性化节点特征，但在很大程度上忽视了结构知识的作用，导致消息传递期间出现聚合引起的表示漂移。

sentences.en: We observe that structural heterogeneity often originates from feature-driven connection biases shaped by local data collection practices or user preferences.
sentences.zh: 我们观察到，结构异构性往往源于由本地数据采集实践或用户偏好塑造的特征驱动连接偏差。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose \textbf{Fed-Kalter}, a novel FGL framework that integrates Kalman filtering principles into graph neural networks.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出 \textbf{Fed-Kalter}，一个将卡尔曼滤波原理整合到图神经网络中的新颖 FGL 框架。

sentences.en: Fed-Kalter introduces Kalter-Conv, a graph convolution grounded in a Kalman framework with learnable dynamics, which treats structural embeddings as latent states and feature-augmented neighborhoods as noisy observations, thereby filtering feature-induced structural noise in a layer-wise manner.
sentences.zh: Fed-Kalter 引入 Kalter-Conv，一种基于带可学习动力学卡尔曼框架的图卷积，它将结构嵌入视为潜状态，将特征增强的邻域视为带噪观测，从而逐层过滤由特征引发的结构噪声。

sentences.en: Only structural parameters are aggregated globally, enabling effective cross-client knowledge transfer while preserving local personalization.
sentences.zh: 仅结构参数被全局聚合，从而在保留本地个性化的同时实现有效的跨客户端知识迁移。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on 16 graph classification datasets spanning 4 domains demonstrate that Fed-Kalter consistently outperforms state-of-the-art FGL methods.
sentences.zh: 在覆盖 4 个领域的 16 个图分类数据集上的大量实验表明，Fed-Kalter 持续优于最先进的 FGL 方法。

sentences.en: Further ablation and hyperparameter studies confirm its robustness, efficiency, and effectiveness in mitigating structural heterogeneity.
sentences.zh: 进一步的消融与超参数研究证实了其在缓解结构异构性方面的稳健性、高效性与有效性。

title_en: Federated Learning with Unlabeled Clients: Personalization Can Happen in Low Dimensions
title_zh: 具有无标签客户端的联邦学习：个性化可以发生在低维空间

sentences.en: Personalized federated learning has emerged as a popular approach to training on devices holding statistically heterogeneous data, known as clients.
sentences.zh: 个性化联邦学习已成为在保有统计异构数据（即客户端）的设备上进行训练的一种流行方法。

sentences.en: However, most existing approaches require a client to have labeled data for training or finetuning in order to obtain their own personalized model.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的大多数方法都要求客户端拥有带标签的数据用于训练或微调，才能获得自己的个性化模型。

sentences.en: In this paper we address this by proposing FLowDUP, a novel method that is able to generate a personalized model using only a forward pass with unlabeled data.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们通过提出 FLowDUP 来解决这一问题，这是一种新颖方法，仅需对无标签数据做一次前向传播即可生成个性化模型。

sentences.en: The generated model parameters reside in a low-dimensional subspace, enabling efficient communication and computation.
sentences.zh: 所生成的模型参数位于一个低维子空间中，从而实现高效的通信与计算。

sentences.en: FLowDUP's learning objective is theoretically motivated by our new transductive multi-task PAC-Bayesian generalization bound, that provides performance guarantees for unlabeled clients.
sentences.zh: FLowDUP 的学习目标在理论上由我们新的直推式多任务 PAC-贝叶斯泛化界所支撑，该界为无标签客户端提供了性能保证。

sentences.en: The objective is structured in such a way that it allows both clients with labeled data and clients with only unlabeled data to contribute to the training process.
sentences.zh: 该目标结构既允许拥有带标签数据的客户端，也允许仅有无标签数据的客户端参与到训练过程中。

sentences.en: To supplement our theoretical results we carry out a thorough experimental evaluation of FLowDUP, demonstrating strong empirical performance on a range of datasets with differing sorts of statistically heterogeneous clients.
sentences.zh: 为补充我们的理论结果，我们对 FLowDUP 进行了全面的实验评估，在多种具有不同类型统计异构客户端的数据集上展示了强劲的实证性能。

sentences.en: Through numerous ablation studies, we test the efficacy of the individual components of the method.
sentences.zh: 通过大量消融研究，我们检验了该方法各个组件的有效性。

title_en: Federated Manifold Learning (FML): Tackling Domain Heterogeneity with Structural Knowledge Transfer
title_zh: 联邦流形学习（FML）：通过结构知识迁移应对域异质性

sentences.en: Federated Learning (FL) faces significant challenges due to domain heterogeneity, where data from different clients exhibit substantial statistical shifts that hinder the generalization of the global model.
sentences.zh: 联邦学习（FL）因域异构性而面临重大挑战，其中不同客户端的数据表现出显著的统计偏移，阻碍了全局模型的泛化。

sentences.en: Although existing methods attempt to mitigate this by exchanging class prototypes, they fall short by representing an entire class's complex distribution with a single point.
sentences.zh: 虽然现有方法试图通过交换类原型来缓解这一问题，但它们用单个点来表征整个类的复杂分布，因而有所不足。

sentences.en: This oversimplification disregards the rich structural information within the data, especially across diverse domains.
sentences.zh: 这种过度简化忽视了数据中丰富的结构信息，尤其是在跨多样领域的情况下。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, we propose a paradigm shift from point-based representation to structure-based knowledge transfer.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一局限，我们提出从基于点的表示向基于结构的知识迁移的范式转变。

sentences.en: We introduce Federated Manifold Learning (FML), a novel framework that leverages perceptual manifolds—the intrinsic geometric structures of classes in the feature space—as rich knowledge carriers.
sentences.zh: 我们引入联邦流形学习（FML），一个新颖框架，它将感知流形——类别在特征空间中的内在几何结构——作为丰富的知识载体。

sentences.en: In FML, clients transmit compressed manifolds, which are adaptively fused on the server using an attention-based Manifold Mutual Learning (MML) mechanism.
sentences.zh: 在 FML 中，客户端传输压缩后的流形，由服务端使用基于注意力的流形互学习（MML）机制进行自适应融合。

sentences.en: This process enables domain-specific structures to learn from each other, creating a unified yet flexible global convergence target.
sentences.zh: 这一过程使领域特定结构得以相互学习，形成一个统一而灵活的全局收敛目标。

sentences.en: Manifold-guided local training, enforced by a manifold approximation loss and a separation loss, further aligns local models with this global structure.
sentences.zh: 流形引导的本地训练由流形近似损失与分离损失共同约束，进一步将本地模型与该全局结构对齐。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on the Digits and Office31 benchmarks demonstrate that FML substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving accuracy improvements of up to 6.47%.
sentences.zh: 在 Digits 与 Office31 基准上的大量实验表明，FML 大幅优于最先进的方法，准确率提升最高达 6.47%。

title_en: Federated Multi-view Clustering for Remote Sensing Data
title_zh: 遥感数据的联邦多视图聚类

sentences.en: The rapid expansion of remote sensing technology has generated massive amounts of unlabeled multi-view data distributed across different institutions.
sentences.zh: 遥感技术的快速扩张产生了海量、无标签的多视图数据，分布在不同的机构之间。

sentences.en: Analyzing this data presents significant challenges, as centralized processing incurs prohibitive communication costs and raises data privacy concerns.
sentences.zh: 分析这些数据带来重大挑战，因为集中式处理会招致高昂的通信成本，并引发数据隐私问题。

sentences.en: To address these issues, this paper proposes a novel deep federated multi-view clustering (MVC) framework tailored for remote sensing data.
sentences.zh: 为解决这些问题，本文提出一个专为遥感数据定制的新颖深度联邦多视图聚类（MVC）框架。

sentences.en: Unlike existing methods that transmit sensitive data features, our approach shares only privatized prototypes masked with adaptive noise, ensuring both communication efficiency and privacy preservation.
sentences.zh: 与传输敏感数据特征的现有方法不同，我们的方法仅共享以自适应噪声掩蔽的隐私化原型，同时确保通信效率与隐私保护。

sentences.en: First, we employ superpixel segmentation to reduce the spatial dimensionality of remote sensing data, lowering computational burdens.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们采用超像素分割来降低遥感数据的空间维度，减轻计算负担。

sentences.en: Furthermore, to resolve the inconsistency of cluster assignments across different clients, we design a co-occurrence structural alignment module that synchronizes local models.
sentences.zh: 此外，为解决不同客户端之间簇分配不一致的问题，我们设计一个共现结构对齐模块来同步本地模型。

sentences.en: Finally, we incorporate a wasserstein prototype contrastive learning mechanism, which models clusters as distributions rather than points, to enhance global consistency and robustness against data heterogeneity.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们引入一个 Wasserstein 原型对比学习机制，将簇建模为分布而非点，以增强全局一致性并提升对数据异构性的鲁棒性。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on four public datasets demonstrate that our framework achieves superior clustering performance and efficiency compared to state-of-the-art methods.
sentences.zh: 在四个公开数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的框架相较于最先进方法取得了优越的聚类性能与效率。

title_en: Federated Sketching LoRA: A Flexible Framework for Heterogeneous Collaborative Fine-Tuning of LLMs
title_zh: 联邦草图 LoRA：大语言模型异质协作微调的灵活框架

sentences.en: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) on resource-constrained clients remains a challenging problem.
sentences.zh: 在资源受限的客户端上微调大语言模型（LLM）仍是一个具有挑战性的问题。

sentences.en: Recent works have fused low-rank adaptation (LoRA) techniques with federated fine-tuning to mitigate challenges associated with client model sizes and data scarcity.
sentences.zh: 近期工作将低秩适配（LoRA）技术与联邦微调相融合，以缓解与客户端模型规模和数据稀缺相关的挑战。

sentences.en: Still, the heterogeneity of resources remains a critical bottleneck: while higher-rank modules generally enhance performance, varying client capabilities constrain LoRA's feasible rank range.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，资源的异质性仍然是一个关键瓶颈：虽然更高秩的模块通常能提升性能，但各异客户端的能力制约了 LoRA 可行的秩范围。

sentences.en: Existing approaches attempting to resolve this issue either lack analytical justification or impose additional computational overhead, leaving a wide gap for efficient and theoretically-grounded solutions.
sentences.zh: 试图解决这一问题的现有方法要么缺乏解析层面的论证，要么带来额外的计算开销，为高效且有理论支撑的方案留下了很大空白。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose federated sketching LoRA (FSLoRA), which leverages a sketching mechanism to enable clients to selectively update submatrices of global LoRA modules maintained by the server.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出联邦草图化 LoRA（FSLoRA），它利用一种草图化机制，使客户端能够选择性地更新由服务端维护的全局 LoRA 模块的子矩阵。

sentences.en: By adjusting the sketching ratios, which determine the ranks of the submatrices on the clients, FSLoRA flexibly adapts to client-specific communication and computational constraints.
sentences.zh: 通过调整决定客户端上子矩阵秩的草图化比率，FSLoRA 能够灵活地适配客户端特定的通信与计算约束。

sentences.en: We provide a rigorous convergence analysis of FSLoRA that characterizes how the sketching ratios affect the convergence rate.
sentences.zh: 我们为 FSLoRA 提供严谨的收敛性分析，刻画了草图化比率如何影响收敛速率。

sentences.en: Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that FSLoRA outperforms baselines and significantly improves training efficiency while preserving stable convergence.
sentences.zh: 通过大量实验，我们证明 FSLoRA 优于基线，并在保持稳定收敛的同时显著提升训练效率。

title_en: Federated Variational Preference Alignment with Gumbel-Softmax Prior for Personalized User Preferences
title_zh: 采用 Gumbel–Softmax 先验进行联邦变分偏好对齐，满足个性化用户偏好

sentences.en: Federated Learning (FL) offers a privacy-preserving pathway for aligning Large Language Models (LLMs); however, existing frameworks typically enforce a monolithic reward model, inevitably averaging out inherently conflicting user preferences (e.g., helpfulness vs. harmlessness).
sentences.zh: 联邦学习（FL）为对齐大语言模型（LLM）提供了一条保护隐私的路径；然而，现有框架通常强制采用单一整体式奖励模型，不可避免地将本就相互冲突的用户偏好（如有益性 vs. 无害性）平均化。

sentences.en: While Variational Preference Learning (VPL) offers a pathway to personalization, adapting it to decentralized settings presents a fundamental challenge: \textit{posterior collapse} driven by severe local data scarcity and heterogeneity.
sentences.zh: 虽然变分偏好学习（VPL）为个性化提供了一条路径，但将其适配到去中心化环境面临一个根本挑战：\textit{后验坍缩}——由严重的本地数据稀缺与异构性所驱动。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose Federated Variational Preference Alignment with Gumbel-Softmax Prior (FedVPA-GP), a framework designed to disentangle diverse preferences without compromising privacy.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出带 Gumbel-Softmax 先验的联邦变分偏好对齐（FedVPA-GP），一个旨在不失隐私地解缠多样偏好的框架。

sentences.en: To stabilize variational inference, we introduce a Federated Mixture Prior that enables clients to leverage the aggregate population distribution as a dynamic prior.
sentences.zh: 为稳定变分推断，我们引入一个联邦混合先验，使客户端能够将聚合的人群分布用作动态先验。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we incorporate an Orthogonal Loss that explicitly enforces the separation of preference prototypes in the latent space.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们引入一个正交损失，在潜空间中显式强制偏好原型的分离。

sentences.en: Experiments on the HH-RLHF dataset demonstrate that FedVPA-GP significantly outperforms monolithic baselines, successfully disentangling conflicting user intents and enabling dynamic preference switching.
sentences.zh: 在 HH-RLHF 数据集上的实验表明，FedVPA-GP 显著优于整体式基线，成功解缠了相互冲突的用户意图，并实现了动态偏好切换。

title_en: FedFit: Federated Dynamic Sparse Training via Fisher Information scoring
title_zh: FedFit：通过 Fisher 信息评分实现联邦动态稀疏训练

sentences.en: Cross-device Federated Learning (FL) is frequently bottlenecked by the prohibitive memory and communication costs of training deep neural networks on resource-constrained edge hardware.
sentences.zh: 跨设备联邦学习（FL）常常受限于在资源受限的边缘硬件上训练深度神经网络所导致的巨大的内存与通信成本。

sentences.en: While federated dynamic sparse training aims to alleviate these costs by adjusting sparse structures during training, existing methods rely on magnitude-based heuristics that are fundamentally ill-suited for the non-convergent, heterogeneous environments inherent to FL.
sentences.zh: 虽然联邦动态稀疏训练旨在通过调整训练过程中的稀疏结构来缓解这些成本，但现有方法依赖基于幅值的启发式方法，而这些方法从根本上不适合 FL 中固有的不收敛、异构环境。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we propose FedFit, a federated dynamic sparse training framework that replaces simple heuristics with optimization-centric criteria for structure adjustment.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们提出 FedFit，一个联邦动态稀疏训练框架，用面向优化的准则取代简单启发式方法来进行结构调整。

sentences.en: By leveraging a second-order approximation of the loss landscape via the Fisher Information Matrix, FedFit enables precise and efficient structure adjustment without the overhead of explicit Hessian computation.
sentences.zh: 通过利用 Fisher 信息矩阵对损失曲面进行二阶近似，FedFit 能够在无需显式计算 Hessian 的开销下实现精确而高效的结构调整。

sentences.en: Empirical evaluations across computer vision and natural language processing benchmarks demonstrate that FedFit  significantly narrows the sparse-to-dense accuracy gap, outperforming state-of-the-art methods while maintaining high communication efficiency.
sentences.zh: 在计算机视觉与自然语言处理基准上的实证评估表明，FedFit 显著缩小了稀疏到稠密的精度差距，在保持高通信效率的同时优于最先进的方法。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/Serena-28/Fedfit.git.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/Serena-28/Fedfit.git 获取。

title_en: FedGain: Toward Negative-Gain-Free Client Collaboration in Federated Learning
title_zh: FedGain：迈向联邦学习中无负收益的客户端协作

sentences.en: Data heterogeneity is a fundamental challenge in Federated Learning (FL), where induced model drift often results in "negative gains" for global models on data-abundant clients, with performance falling below that of local training.
sentences.zh: 数据异构性是联邦学习（FL）中的一个根本挑战，由其所引致的模型漂移常常导致全局模型在数据充足的客户端上产生“负收益”，性能甚至低于本地训练。

sentences.en: To address this issue, we propose FedGain, a novel framework that optimizes collaborative client clustering to mitigate the negative gain.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出 FedGain，一个通过优化协作性客户端聚类来缓解负收益的新颖框架。

sentences.en: We are the first to develop a modified Scaling Law (SL) to quantify the reduction in data utility caused by heterogeneity and define Effective Federated Capacity to align clients with the highest potential collaboration gains.
sentences.zh: 我们首次开发了一种修正的缩放定律（SL），用以量化异构性所导致的数据效用下降，并定义有效联邦容量，以将客户端与具有最高潜在协作收益的对象对齐。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that our modified SL strictly adheres to the power-law learning discipline in non-IID scenarios.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，我们的修正 SL 在非 IID 场景中严格遵循幂律学习规律。

sentences.en: FedGain effectively suppresses negative gains to a negligible level across various FL algorithms and outperforms other Clustered FL methods.
sentences.zh: FedGain 在多种 FL 算法中有效地将负收益抑制到可忽略的水平，并优于其他聚类式 FL 方法。

title_en: FedHera: Towards Drift-Resilient Federated Fine-tuning with Heterogeneous Resources
title_zh: FedHera：迈向异质资源下抗漂移的联邦微调

sentences.en: Driven by the imperative to leverage privacy-sensitive data scattered across decentralized devices, federated fine-tuning has emerged as a vital paradigm for adapting large language models without compromising data privacy.
sentences.zh: 在充分利用分布在去中心化设备上的隐私敏感数据的推动下，联邦微调已成为在不牺牲数据隐私的前提下适配大语言模型的一种重要范式。

sentences.en: Yet, its practical efficacy is bottlenecked by severe client resource heterogeneity.
sentences.zh: 然而，其实际效力受到严重的客户端资源异构性的制约。

sentences.en: Existing truncation-based methods typically couple the transmitted rank with the trainable rank, which (i) under-utilizes bandwidth on communication-rich but compute-limited clients and (ii) exacerbates truncation-induced gradient drift.
sentences.zh: 现有的基于截断的方法通常将传输的秩与可训练的秩耦合在一起，这会 (i) 在通信充裕但计算受限的客户端上未能充分利用带宽，并且 (ii) 加剧由截断引起的梯度漂移。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose FedHera, a resource-decoupled framework that explicitly differentiates information reception from gradient optimization.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出 FedHera，一个资源解耦的框架，将信息接收与梯度优化明确加以区分。

sentences.en: FedHera employs a spectrum-preserving allocation strategy to maximize the transfer of global knowledge (via high-rank singular values) within bandwidth limits, irrespective of training constraints.
sentences.zh: FedHera 采用一种保谱分配策略，在带宽限制内最大化全局知识（通过高秩奇异值）的传输，而无论训练约束如何。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we introduce a prefix-gating mechanism that utilizes the downloaded high-capacity basis as a frozen reference to guide local updates, thereby minimizing the optimization gap caused by aggressive truncation.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们引入一个前缀门控机制，将下载的高容量基作为冻结的参考来引导本地更新，从而最小化由激进截断造成的优化差距。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments under different heterogeneous settings show that FedHera improves stability and accuracy over state-of-the-art baselines.
sentences.zh: 在不同异构设定下的大量实验表明，FedHera 在稳定性与准确率上均优于最先进的基线。

title_en: FedHPro: Federated Hyper-Prototype Learning via Gradient Matching
title_zh: FedHPro：通过梯度匹配实现联邦超原型学习

sentences.en: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative training of distributed clients while protecting privacy.
sentences.zh: 联邦学习（FL）在保护隐私的同时，支持对分布式客户端的协作训练。

sentences.en: To enhance generalization capability in FL, prototype-based FL is in the spotlight, since shared global prototypes offer semantic anchors for aligning client-specific local prototypes.
sentences.zh: 为增强 FL 中的泛化能力，基于原型的 FL 备受关注，因为共享的全局原型为对齐各客户端特有的局部原型提供了语义锚点。

sentences.en: However, existing methods update global prototypes at the prototype-level via averaging local prototypes or refining global anchors, which often leads to semantic drift across clients and subsequently yields a misaligned global signal.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法在原型层面通过平均局部原型或精化全局锚点来更新全局原型，这往往导致跨客户端的语义漂移，进而产生未对齐的全局信号。

sentences.en: To alleviate this issue, we introduce **hyper-prototypes**, defined by a set of learnable global class-wise prototypes to preserve underlying semantic knowledge across clients.
sentences.zh: 为缓解这一问题，我们引入 **超原型**，它由一组可学习的全局逐类原型定义，以在各客户端间保留底层的语义知识。

sentences.en: The hyper-prototypes are optimized via gradient matching to align with class-relevant characteristics distilled directly from clients' real samples, rather than prototype-level descriptors.
sentences.zh: 超原型通过梯度匹配进行优化，使其与直接从客户端真实样本中提炼的类别相关特征对齐，而非与原型层面的描述符对齐。

sentences.en: We further propose **FedHPro**, a Federated Hyper-Prototype Learning framework, to leverage hyper-prototypes to promote inter-class separability via mutual-contrastive learning with client-specific margin, while encouraging intra-class uniformity through a consistency penalty.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步提出 **FedHPro**，一个联邦超原型学习框架，利用超原型通过带客户端特定间隔的互对比学习提升类间可分性，同时通过一致性惩罚鼓励类内均匀性。

sentences.en: Comprehensive experiments under diverse heterogeneous scenarios confirm that 1) hyper-prototypes produce a more semantically consistent global signal, and 2) FedHPro achieves state-of-the-art performance on several benchmark datasets.
sentences.zh: 在不同异构场景下的大量实验证实：1) 超原型能够产生语义更一致的全局信号；2) FedHPro 在多个基准数据集上达到了最先进的性能。

authors.name: Huan Wang
authors.institution: University of Wollongong & Singapore Management University

title_en: FedLog: Personalized Federated Classification with Less Communication and More Flexibility
title_zh: FedLog：通信更少、灵活性更高的个性化联邦分类

sentences.en: Federated representation learning (FRL) aims to learn personalized federated models with effective feature extraction from local data.
sentences.zh: 联邦表示学习（FRL）旨在学习能够从本地数据中进行有效特征提取的个性化联邦模型。

sentences.en: FRL algorithms that share the majority of the model parameters face significant challenges with huge communication overhead.
sentences.zh: 共享大部分模型参数的 FRL 算法面临巨大的通信开销这一重大挑战。

sentences.en: This overhead stems from the millions of neural network parameters and slow aggregation progress of the averaging heuristic.
sentences.zh: 这种开销源于数百万个神经网络参数，以及平均化启发式方法缓慢的聚合进度。

sentences.en: To reduce the overhead, we propose FedLog, which shares sufficient data summaries instead of raw model parameters.
sentences.zh: 为降低开销，我们提出 FedLog，它共享充分的数据摘要，而非原始模型参数。

sentences.en: The data summaries encode minimal sufficient statistics of an exponential family, and Bayesian inference is utilized for global aggregation.
sentences.zh: 这些数据摘要编码了指数族的最小充分统计量，并利用贝叶斯推断进行全局聚合。

sentences.en: FedLog helps  reduce message sizes and communication frequency.
sentences.zh: FedLog 有助于减小消息大小并降低通信频率。

sentences.en: We prove that the shared messages are minimal sufficient statistics and theoretically analyze the convergence rate of FedLog.
sentences.zh: 我们证明所共享的消息是最小充分统计量，并从理论上分析 FedLog 的收敛速率。

sentences.en: To further ensure formal privacy guarantees, we extend FedLog with the differential privacy framework.
sentences.zh: 为进一步确保形式上的隐私保证，我们利用差分隐私框架对 FedLog 进行扩展。

sentences.en: Empirical results demonstrate high learning accuracy with low communication overhead of our method.
sentences.zh: 实证结果表明，我们的方法在低通信开销下实现了高学习准确率。

authors.institution: University of Waterloo and Vector Institute

title_en: FedPAT: Federated Test-Time Adaptation via Prototype Affinity Topology
title_zh: FedPAT：通过原型亲和拓扑实现联邦测试时适应

sentences.en: Federated Learning (FL) enables privacy-preserving collaboration among distributed clients in open-world environments, but its performance often degrades under data heterogeneity and unpredictable distribution shifts.
sentences.zh: 联邦学习（FL）能够在开放世界环境中支持分布式客户端之间的隐私保护协作，但其性能在数据异构性与不可预测的分布偏移下往往会下降。

sentences.en: Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) has recently been introduced into FL to leverage unlabeled data from unseen clients for online adaptation.
sentences.zh: 测试时自适应（TTA）近来被引入 FL，以利用来自未见客户端的无标签数据进行在线自适应。

sentences.en: However, most existing federated TTA methods employ local feature statistics, which can be brittle under diverse and severe distribution shifts.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的大多数联邦 TTA 方法都采用局部特征统计量，这在多样而严重的分布偏移下可能很脆弱。

sentences.en: In this work, we observe that despite significant variations in feature distributions, the relational structure among class prototypes—termed *prototype affinity topology*—remains remarkably stable across heterogeneous clients.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们观察到，尽管特征分布存在显著差异，但类原型之间的关系结构——称为 *原型亲缘拓扑*——在异构客户端之间仍然非常稳定。

sentences.en: Building on this insight, we propose FedPAT, a **Fed**erated TTA framework that leverages **P**rototype **A**ffinity **T**opology as a cross-client structural prior.
sentences.zh: 基于这一洞见，我们提出 FedPAT，一个将 **原型亲缘拓扑** 作为跨客户端结构先验的 **联邦** TTA 框架。

sentences.en: FedPAT learns a global PAT by aggregating class prototypes from source clients, capturing consensus inter-class relationships that are robust to local distribution variations.
sentences.zh: FedPAT 通过聚合源客户端的类原型来学习全局 PAT，捕获对本地分布变化稳健的一致性类间关系。

sentences.en: For unseen target clients, we design a topology-aware mechanism that enhances predictions via diffusion of the global PAT, fuses them with parametric outputs, and performs lightweight optimization for robust test-time adaptation.
sentences.zh: 对于未见的目标客户端，我们设计一种拓扑感知机制，通过全局 PAT 的扩散来增强预测，将其与参数化输出融合，并执行轻量级优化以实现稳健的测试时自适应。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that FedPAT consistently outperforms advanced federated TTA and classical TTA methods across various distribution shifts.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，FedPAT 在各种分布偏移下始终优于先进的联邦 TTA 与经典 TTA 方法。

title_en: FedPDG: Prediction Discrepancy–Guided Data Generation for Heterogeneous Federated Learning
title_zh: FedPDG：预测差异引导的数据生成，用于异质联邦学习

sentences.en: One emerging approach to mitigating data heterogeneity in Federated Learning (FL) is to employ diffusion models to generate synthetic data for clients, thereby aligning local data distributions with the global distribution.
sentences.zh: 缓解联邦学习（FL）中数据异构性的一个新兴方法，是利用扩散模型为客户端生成合成数据，从而使本地数据分布与全局分布对齐。

sentences.en: Prior work has primarily focused on balance-oriented augmentation, which assumes a balanced global class distribution and thus generates samples of rare classes to rebalance each client's local dataset.
sentences.zh: 先前的工作主要聚焦于以平衡为导向的数据增强，这假设全局类分布是平衡的，因此会生成稀有类的样本以重新平衡各客户端的本地数据集。

sentences.en: However, in practice, global data distributions are often inherently imbalanced.
sentences.zh: 然而在实际中，全局数据分布往往是天生不平衡的。

sentences.en: Moreover, privacy constraints in FL hinder the server’s ability to accurately estimate the global distribution, rendering balance-oriented augmentation suboptimal.
sentences.zh: 此外，FL 中的隐私约束阻碍了服务端准确估计全局分布的能力，使以平衡为导向的数据增强变得次优。

sentences.en: This raises a key, underexplored challenge: How can synthetic data be generated and selected to align local distributions with the true, yet unknown, global distribution?
sentences.zh: 这就引出一个关键的、尚未充分探索的挑战：如何生成并选择合成数据，使本地分布与真实却未知的全局分布对齐？

sentences.en: Our key insight is that a model’s performance implicitly reflects the data distribution it has been trained on.
sentences.zh: 我们的关键洞见是：模型的性能会隐含地反映其所训练的数据分布。

sentences.en: Based on this observation, we use the performance discrepancy between local and global models to identify the regions where each client’s local dataset is lacking, and generate corresponding samples for clients.
sentences.zh: 基于这一观察，我们利用本地模型与全局模型之间的性能差异来识别各客户端本地数据集缺失的区域，并为客户端生成相应样本。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we adapt the diffusion model via preference optimization, enabling it to generate data that better aligns with the true global distribution.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们通过偏好优化来适配扩散模型，使其能够生成与真实全局分布更对齐的数据。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that FedPDG outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving up to 3.82\% improvement.
sentences.zh: 在多个基准上的大量实验表明，FedPDG 优于最先进的方法，实现了最高 3.82\% 的提升。

title_en: FedPissa: Towards Federated Personalized Adaptation of Foundation Models via LoRA Subspace Mapping
title_zh: FedPissa：通过 LoRA 子空间映射实现基础模型的联邦个性化适配

sentences.en: LoRA efficiently adapts large pre-trained models via low-rank updates, making it a strong parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) method.
sentences.zh: LoRA 通过低秩更新高效地适配大型预训练模型，使其成为一种强大的参数高效微调（PEFT）方法。

sentences.en: When integrated with Federated Learning (FL), it enables collaborative fine-tuning across distributed clients, leveraging rich downstream data without exposing private information.
sentences.zh: 当与联邦学习（FL）集成时，它能够支持跨分布式客户端的协作微调，充分利用丰富的下游数据而不暴露私有信息。

sentences.en: However, this strategy is hindered by data heterogeneity and limits personalization performance.
sentences.zh: 然而，这一策略受到数据异构性的阻碍，限制了个性化性能。

sentences.en: To address this, personalized FedLoRA approaches have been proposed and employ a dual-LoRA architecture, e.g., one branch for global knowledge and another for client-specific adaptation.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，已有研究者提出个性化 FedLoRA 方法，采用双 LoRA 架构，例如一个分支用于全局知识，另一个分支用于客户端特定适配。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, this dual-LoRA design introduces additional computational overhead and structural redundancy.
sentences.zh: 然而，这种双 LoRA 设计引入了额外的计算开销与结构冗余。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, we propose FedPissa, the first framework that rethinks single-LoRA via selective aggregation and subspace decorrelation.
sentences.zh: 为克服这一局限，我们提出 FedPissa，这是第一个通过选择性聚合与子空间去相关来重新审视单 LoRA 的框架。

sentences.en: We selectively aggregate LoRA components based on their aggregation dynamics, and further apply a decorrelated subspace projection to mitigate heterogeneous update conflicts, reducing cross-client interference and improving personalized adaptation.
sentences.zh: 我们依据 LoRA 组件的聚合动态对其进行选择性聚合，并进一步应用去相关子空间投影来缓解异构更新冲突，从而减少跨客户端干扰并改进个性化适配。

sentences.en: Experiments on textual and visual scenarios show that FedPissa not only achieves up to 35% lower communication and computation cost, but also improves overall accuracy by up to 8% compared to its counterparts.
sentences.zh: 在文本与视觉场景上的实验表明，FedPissa 不仅将通信与计算成本降低了最高 35%，而且相较对应方法将整体准确率提升了最高 8%。

title_en: FedQueue: Queue-Aware Federated Learning for Cross-Facility HPC Training
title_zh: FedQueue：用于跨设施高性能计算训练的队列感知联邦学习

sentences.en: Federated learning~(FL) across multiple HPC facilities faces stochastic admission delays from batch schedulers that dominate wall-clock time.
sentences.zh: 跨多个 HPC 设施的联邦学习（FL）面临来自批处理调度器的随机入队延迟，这些延迟主导了墙钟时间。

sentences.en: Synchronous FL suffers from severe stragglers, while asynchronous FL accumulates stale updates when queues spike.
sentences.zh: 同步 FL 遭受严重的落伍者问题，而异步 FL 在队列飙升时会积累陈旧更新。

sentences.en: We propose FedQueue, a queue-aware FL protocol that incorporates scheduler delays directly into training and aggregation, which (i) predicts per-facility queue delays online to budget local work, (ii) applies cutoff-based admission that buffers late arrivals to bound staleness, and (iii) performs staleness-aware aggregation to stabilize heterogeneous local workloads.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 FedQueue，一个队列感知的 FL 协议，它将调度器延迟直接纳入训练与聚合之中，具体地：(i) 在线预测各设施的队列延迟以规划本地工作量；(ii) 采用基于截止时间的准入机制，缓冲迟到的到达以限制陈旧性；(iii) 执行陈旧感知的聚合，以稳定异构的本地工作负载。

sentences.en: We prove the convergence for non-convex objectives at rate $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{R})$ under bounded staleness, and show that the admission controls yield bounded staleness with high probability under queue-prediction error.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，在有界陈旧性下，非凸目标的收敛速率为 $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{R})$，并表明在队列预测误差下，准入控制能以高概率保证有界陈旧性。

sentences.en: Real-world cross-facility deployment of FedQueue shows 20.5\% improvement over baseline algorithms.
sentences.zh: FedQueue 的真实跨设施部署相比基线算法提升了 20.5\%。

sentences.en: Controlled queue simulations demonstrate robust improvement over the baselines; in particular, up to 60\% reduction in time to reach a target accuracy level under high queue variance and non-IID partitions.
sentences.zh: 受控队列仿真表明，相对基线有稳健的提升；尤其是在队列方差高且采用非 IID 划分的情况下，达到目标准确率所需的时间最多减少了 60%。

authors.name: Ravi Madduri
authors.institution: Argonne National Laboratory and University of Chicago

title_en: FedReLa: Imbalanced Federated Learning via Re-Labeling
title_zh: FedReLa：通过重新标注进行不平衡联邦学习

sentences.en: Federated learning has emerged as the foremost approach for decentralized model training with privacy preserving.
sentences.zh: 联邦学习已成为保护隐私的去中心化模型训练的首要方法。

sentences.en: The global class imbalance and cross-client data heterogeneity naturally coexist, and the mismatch between local and global imbalances exacerbates the performance degradation of the aggregated model.
sentences.zh: 全局类不平衡与跨客户端数据异构性天然共存，而本地与全局不平衡之间的不匹配会加剧聚合模型性能的下降。

sentences.en: The agnosticism of global class distribution poses significant challenges for data-level methods, especially under extreme conditions with severe class absence across clients.
sentences.zh: 对全局类分布的无知给数据级方法带来了重大挑战，尤其是在极端情形下——客户端之间存在严重的类别缺失。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose FedReLa, a novel data-level approach that tackles the coexistence of data heterogeneity and class imbalance in federated learning.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出 FedReLa，一种新颖的数据级方法，应对联邦学习中数据异构性与类不平衡共存的问题。

sentences.en: By re-labeling samples with a feature-dependent label re-allocator, FedReLa corrects biased global decision boundaries without requiring knowledge of the global class distribution.
sentences.zh: 通过使用依赖特征的重分配器对样本进行重标注，FedReLa 无需了解全局类分布即可纠正有偏差的全局决策边界。

sentences.en: This modular, model-agnostic approach can be integrated with algorithmic methods to deliver consistent improvements without additional communication overhead.
sentences.zh: 这种模块化、与模型无关的方法可以与算法方法集成，在无需额外通信开销的情况下带来一致的改进。

sentences.en: Through extensive experiments, our method significantly improves the accuracy of minority classes and the overall accuracy on stepwise-imbalanced and long-tailed datasets, outperforming the previous state of the art.
sentences.zh: 通过大量实验，我们的方法显著提升了少数类的准确率以及在逐步不平衡与长尾数据集上的总体准确率，超越了先前的最先进方法。

title_en: FedRGL: Robust Federated Graph Learning under Label Noise
title_zh: FedRGL：标签噪声下的鲁棒联邦图学习

sentences.en: Federated Graph Learning (FGL) is a distributed machine learning paradigm based on graph neural networks, enabling secure and collaborative modeling of local graph data among clients.
sentences.zh: 联邦图学习（FGL）是一种基于图神经网络的分布式机器学习范式，能够在客户端之间实现本地图数据的安全协作建模。

sentences.en: However, label noise in graph data can degrade the generalization performance of the global model.
sentences.zh: 然而，图数据中的标签噪声会降低全局模型的泛化性能。

sentences.en: Existing federated label noise learning methods, primarily focused on computer vision tasks, often yield suboptimal results when directly applied to FGL.
sentences.zh: 现有的联邦标签噪声学习方法主要聚焦于计算机视觉任务，直接应用于 FGL 时往往得到次优结果。

sentences.en: To address this issue, we propose a robust federated graph learning method with label noise, termed **FedRGL**.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出一种抗标签噪声的稳健联邦图学习方法，称为 **FedRGL**。

sentences.en: Specifically, FedRGL leverages the globally aggregated model and local subgraph structural information to implement a dual-perspective consistency noise-node filtering mechanism under class-aware dynamic thresholds.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，FedRGL 利用全局聚合模型与本地子图结构信息，在类别感知的动态阈值下实现一种双视角一致性噪声节点过滤机制。

sentences.en: The resulting *class-aware dual-consistency filtering (CADF)* can also serve as a plug-and-play module, enhancing noise robustness across various subgraph federated learning frameworks.
sentences.zh: 所得到的 *类别感知双一致性过滤（CADF）* 还可以作为即插即用模块，增强各种子图联邦学习框架的噪声鲁棒性。

sentences.en: To better exploit the supervisory information from filtered noisy nodes, we employ the natural augmentation techniques from graph contrastive learning to assign high-confidence pseudo-labels to the noise nodes.
sentences.zh: 为更好地利用经滤噪节点提供的有监督信息，我们采用图对比学习中的自然增强技术，为噪声节点分配高置信度的伪标签。

sentences.en: Additionally, we measure model quality via the average predictive entropy of unlabeled nodes, enabling adaptive robust aggregation on the server side.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们通过未标记节点的平均预测熵来衡量模型质量，从而在服务端实现自适应的稳健聚合。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on real-world graph datasets show that FedRGL consistently outperforms existing methods under different noise rates, noise types, and client scales, achieving on average **5--8\%** higher accuracy and up to **30\%** improvement over the weakest baselines under noisy conditions.
sentences.zh: 在真实世界图数据集上的大量实验表明，FedRGL 在不同噪声率、噪声类型与客户端规模下都持续优于现有方法，在噪声条件下平均准确率提升 **5--8\%**，对最弱基线最高提升 **30\%**。

sentences.en: The source code is available at https://github.com/LDer66/FEDRGL-ICML26.
sentences.zh: 源代码可在 https://github.com/LDer66/FEDRGL-ICML26 获取。

title_en: FedRot-LoRA: Mitigating Rotational Misalignment in Federated LoRA
title_zh: FedRot-LoRA：缓解联邦 LoRA 中的旋转失配

sentences.en: Federated LoRA provides a communication-efficient mechanism for fine-tuning large language models on decentralized data.
sentences.zh: 联邦 LoRA 为在去中心化数据上微调大语言模型提供了通信高效的机制。

sentences.en: In practice, however, a discrepancy between the factor-wise averaging used to preserve low rank and the mathematically correct aggregation of local updates can cause significant aggregation error and unstable training.
sentences.zh: 然而在实践中，用于保持低秩的逐因子平均与本地更新的数学正确聚合之间存在差异，可能导致显著的聚合误差与不稳定的训练。

sentences.en: We argue that a major source of this problem is *rotational misalignment*, arising from the rotational invariance of low-rank factorizations -- semantically equivalent updates can be represented in different latent subspaces across clients since $(B_i R_i)(R_i^\top A_i)
sentences.zh: 我们认为这一问题的主要来源是 *旋转未对齐*，它源于低秩因子分解的旋转不变性——由于 $(B_i R_i)(R_i^\top A_i)$

sentences.en: = B_i A_i$.
sentences.zh: = B_i A_i$，语义等价的更新在不同客户端所处的不同潜子空间中表示。

sentences.en: When such misaligned factors are averaged directly, they interfere destructively and degrade the global update.
sentences.zh: 当这种未对齐的因子被直接平均时，它们会发生破坏性干扰，从而损害全局更新。

sentences.en: To address this issue, we propose **FedRot-LoRA**, a federated LoRA framework that aligns client updates via orthogonal transformations prior to aggregation.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出 **FedRot-LoRA**，一个在聚合之前通过正交变换对齐客户端更新的联邦 LoRA 框架。

sentences.en: This alignment preserves the semantic update while reducing cross-client subspace mismatch, without increasing communication cost or restricting model expressivity.
sentences.zh: 这种对齐在保持语义更新的同时，减少了跨客户端子空间不匹配，且不增加通信成本或限制模型表达力。

sentences.en: We provide a convergence analysis that examines the aggregation error induced by factor-wise averaging and shows how rotational alignment yields a tighter upper bound on this error.
sentences.zh: 我们提供一项收敛性分析，考察逐因子平均所引发的聚合误差，并展示旋转对齐如何为该误差给出更紧的上界。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on natural language understanding and generative tasks demonstrate that FedRot-LoRA consistently outperforms existing federated LoRA baselines across a range of heterogeneity levels and LoRA ranks.
sentences.zh: 在自然语言理解与生成任务上的大量实验表明，FedRot-LoRA 在各种异构程度与 LoRA 秩下都持续优于现有联邦 LoRA 基线。

sentences.en: The code is available at https://github.com/haoran-zh/FedRot-LoRA.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/haoran-zh/FedRot-LoRA 获取。

title_en: FedScar: Correcting Geometric Bias for Flatness-Consistent Federated Learning
title_zh: FedScar：校正几何偏差，实现平坦度一致的联邦学习

sentences.en: Federated Learning (FL) often suffers from degraded generalization under statistical heterogeneity, where client updates systematically deviate from the global objective.
sentences.zh: 联邦学习（FL）在统计异构性下往往遭受泛化能力下降之苦，其中客户端更新会系统地偏离全局目标。

sentences.en: While recent Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) methods promote locally flat solutions, they implicitly assume that local flatness transfers to the global model, which generally does not hold under heterogeneous data distributions.
sentences.zh: 虽然近期的锐度感知最小化（SAM）方法促进局部平坦解的取得，但它们隐含假设局部平坦性会传递到全局模型，而这在异构数据分布下通常并不成立。

sentences.en: This mismatch gives rise to a flatness discrepancy induced by misaligned loss landscapes.
sentences.zh: 这种不匹配会引发由损失曲面未对齐所造成的平坦性差异。

sentences.en: To address this issue, we propose FedScar, a federated optimization framework that explicitly corrects heterogeneityinduced geometric inconsistency.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出 FedScar，一个显式校正异构性引发的几何不一致性的联邦优化框架。

sentences.en: FedScar maintains a history-accumulated geometric bias to capture persistent curvature skew across clients, and employs a variance-aware injection mechanism to steer local updates toward regions that are flat with respect to the global objective.
sentences.zh: FedScar 维护一个历史累积的几何偏差，以捕捉跨客户端的持久曲率偏斜，并采用一种方差感知的注入机制，将本地更新引向关于全局目标而言平坦的区域。

sentences.en: We provide a theoretical interpretation of FedScar as a Split-Dual ADMM formulation, which jointly enforces parameter consensus and geometric alignment.
sentences.zh: 我们为 FedScar 提供一种理论上可解释的公式，将其表述为 Split-Dual ADMM 形式，它同时强制参数共识与几何对齐。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments under severe heterogeneity demonstrate that FedScar consistently reduces flatness discrepancy and improves generalization over state-of-the-art methods, without incurring additional communication overhead.
sentences.zh: 在严重异构性下的大量实验表明，FedScar 持续减小平坦性差异并相较最先进方法提升泛化性能，且不产生额外通信开销。

sentences.en: The source code is available at https://github.com/Ultraman6/FedScar.
sentences.zh: 源代码可在 https://github.com/Ultraman6/FedScar 获取。

title_en: FedSDR: Federated Self-Distillation with Rectification
title_zh: FedSDR：带校正的联邦自蒸馏

sentences.en: Federated fine-tuning of Large Language Models faces severe statistical heterogeneity.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型的联邦微调面临严重的统计异构性。

sentences.en: However, existing model-level defenses often overlook the root cause: intrinsic data distribution mismatches.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有模型级防御往往忽视了根本原因：内在的数据分布不匹配。

sentences.en: In this work, we first establish Federated Self-Distillation (FedSD) as a fundamental and potent strategy.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们首先将联邦自蒸馏（FedSD）确立为一种基础而有力的策略。

sentences.en: By projecting client representations into a smoothed ``model-understanding space,'' FedSD alone serves as a universal booster, demonstrating superior performance over conventional algorithms.
sentences.zh: 通过将客户端表示投影到一个平滑的“模型理解空间”中，仅凭 FedSD 就能充当通用助推器，展现出优于常规算法的性能。

sentences.en: Despite its success, we identify a subtle trade-off termed the Rewrite Paradox---unconstrained self-distillation can inadvertently increase hallucinations and redundancy.
sentences.zh: 尽管取得了成功，我们仍识别出一个细微的权衡，称为重写悖论——不受约束的自蒸馏可能会无意中增加幻觉与冗余。

sentences.en: To refine this paradigm, we further propose FedSDR (Federated Self-Distillation with Rectification), the ultimate reinforced framework.
sentences.zh: 为精炼这一范式，我们进一步提出 FedSDR（带校正的联邦自蒸馏），即最终的强化框架。

sentences.en: It augments FedSD with a dual-stream mechanism: a local LoRA-S (Smoothing) branch to implicitly absorb heterogeneity via distilled data, and a parallel global LoRA-R (Rectification) branch anchored to raw data to enforce factual correctness.
sentences.zh: 它通过双流机制增强 FedSD：一个本地 LoRA-S（平滑）分支通过蒸馏数据隐含地吸收异构性，以及一个锚定于原始数据的并行全局 LoRA-R（校正）分支，以强制事实正确性。

sentences.en: By selectively aggregating only LoRA-R, FedSDR yields a globally aligned and faithful model.
sentences.zh: 通过仅选择性聚合 LoRA-R，FedSDR 得到一个全局对齐且忠实的模型。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments verify its superior performance.
sentences.zh: 大量实验验证了其优越性能。

title_en: FedSSM: State Space Model-based Proactive Inference for Heterogeneous Multimodal Federated Learning
title_zh: FedSSM：基于状态空间模型的主动推理，用于异质多模态联邦学习

sentences.en: Multimodal Federated Learning (MMFL) addresses collaborative training across clients with heterogeneous modality configurations, where effective client selection becomes critical under the compounded challenges of modality, distribution, and quantity heterogeneity.
sentences.zh: 多模态联邦学习（MMFL）解决跨具有异构成分配置的客户端的协同训练问题，其中在模态、分布与数量异构的叠加挑战下，有效的客户端选择变得至关重要。

sentences.en: Existing selection methods operate within a reactive paradigm, responding to current observations without anticipating how decisions influence future optimization trajectories.
sentences.zh: 现有的选择方法在反应式范式中运行，对当前观察作出响应，而不预期决策如何影响未来的优化轨迹。

sentences.en: This myopic approach leads to suboptimal convergence when training dynamics shift rapidly under severe heterogeneity.
sentences.zh: 这种短视的方法在严重异构性下训练动态快速变化时，会导致次优收敛。

sentences.en: We propose FedSSM, which reconceptualizes client selection as a proactive decision-making process by predicting training dynamics through decision-aware state space models.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 FedSSM，它通过决策感知的状态空间模型预测训练动态，将客户端选择重新概念化为一个主动决策过程。

sentences.en: The prediction error yields a \emph{surprise} signal that quantifies uncertainty and governs adaptive participation budgets and exploration-exploitation trade-offs via counterfactual reasoning over candidate actions.
sentences.zh: 预测误差产生一个 \emph{意外} 信号，该信号量化不确定性，并通过候选动作上的反事实推理来支配自适应的参与预算与探索-利用权衡。

sentences.en: For aggregation, we introduce trust-weighted fusion with modality-specific routing, where surprise calibrates sensitivity to client anomalies.
sentences.zh: 对于聚合，我们引入带模态特定路由的信任加权融合，其中意外信号校准对客户端异常的敏感性。

sentences.en: Experiments on four multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that FedSSM achieves 2.5--4.5\% accuracy improvements over state-of-the-art methods while reducing communication rounds by over 30\%.
sentences.zh: 在四个多模态基准上的实验表明，FedSSM 相较最先进方法实现了 2.5--4.5\% 的准确率提升，同时将通信轮次减少了超过 30\%。

title_en: FedTreeLoRA: Reconciling Statistical and Functional Heterogeneity in Federated LoRA Fine-Tuning
title_zh: FedTreeLoRA：协调联邦 LoRA 微调中的统计与功能异质性

sentences.en: Federated Learning (FL) with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has become a standard for privacy-preserving LLM fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 带低秩适配（LoRA）的联邦学习（FL）已成为保护隐私的 LLM 微调的标准做法。

sentences.en: However, existing personalized methods predominantly operated under a restrictive Flat-Model Assumption: they addressed client-side *statistical heterogeneity* but treated the model as a monolithic block, ignoring the *functional heterogeneity* across LLM layers.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的个性化方法主要在一个限制性的平面模型假设下运作：它们处理客户端侧的 *统计异构性*，但将模型视为一个整体块，忽视了跨 LLM 层的 *功能异构性*。

sentences.en: We argue that these two statistical (horizontal) and functional (vertical) dimensions, are *orthogonal in source yet coupled in interaction*, implying that the optimal depth of parameter sharing is functionally dependent on client similarity.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，这两个统计（水平）与功能（垂直）维度 *在来源上正交，但在交互中耦合*，这意味着参数共享的最优深度在功能上依赖于客户端相似度。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose **FedTreeLoRA**, a framework employing tree-structured aggregation for fine-grained, layer-wise alignment.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出 **FedTreeLoRA**，一个采用树状聚合以实现细粒度、逐层对齐的框架。

sentences.en: By dynamically constructing an aggregation hierarchy, FedTreeLoRA allows clients to share broad consensus on shallow ’trunks‘ while progressively specializing on deep ‘branches'.
sentences.zh: 通过动态构建聚合层级，FedTreeLoRA 允许客户端在浅层“主干”上共享广泛共识，同时渐进地专业化于深层“分支”。

sentences.en: Experiments on NLU and NLG benchmarks demonstrate that FedTreeLoRA significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods by effectively reconciling generalization and personalization.
sentences.zh: 在 NLU 与 NLG 基准上的实验表明，FedTreeLoRA 通过有效调和泛化与个性化，显著优于最先进的方法。

title_en: FedUSD: Unbiased Synthetic Data for Federated Learning
title_zh: FedUSD：用于联邦学习的无偏合成数据

sentences.en: Aggregation-Free Federated Learning enables joint training by sharing synthetic data, aiming to eliminate data heterogeneity across clients.
sentences.zh: 免聚合联邦学习通过共享合成数据实现联合训练，旨在消除客户端之间的数据异构性。

sentences.en: However, existing methods fail to explicitly separate the principal and residual components of dataset, leading to biased synthetic data.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法未能显式分离数据集的主成分与残差成分，导致合成数据有偏。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose a novel Unbiased Synthetic Data optimization method FedUSD for Aggregation-Free Federated Learning, which is achieved by exploring the High-energy Orthogonal Base (HOB) and variance of dataset in feature space.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出一种新颖的无偏合成数据优化方法 FedUSD，用于免聚合联邦学习，它通过探索特征空间中数据集的高能正交基（HOB）与方差来实现。

sentences.en: Our FedUSD is inspired by the discovery that principal component concentrates in HOB while residual component independently reflects in variance, regardless of networks.
sentences.zh: 我们的 FedUSD 受到如下发现的启发：无论网络如何，主成分都集中在 HOB 中，而残差成分则独立地反映在方差中。

sentences.en: Based on the observation, we develop a method that mathematically optimizes synthetic data by matching both HOB and variance with those of real data.
sentences.zh: 基于这一观察，我们开发了一种方法，通过同时匹配合成数据与真实数据的 HOB 和方差，从数学上优化合成数据。

sentences.en: Besides, we experimentally show the superior effectiveness of leveraging HOB and variance to separately extract the principal and residual components over existing methods.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们通过实验表明，在分别提取主成分与残差成分方面，利用 HOB 与方差的优越有效性超过了现有方法。

sentences.en: We also theoretically prove that FedUSD achieves unbiased synthetic data and thus convergence.
sentences.zh: 我们还在理论上证明 FedUSD 能实现无偏合成数据，从而实现收敛。

sentences.en: Without introducing any constraints, FedUSD thereby yields significant improvements over the state-of-the-arts in terms of global model performance, under equivalent communicational costs.
sentences.zh: 在不引入任何约束的情况下，在相同通信成本下，FedUSD 在全局模型性能上相较最先进方法取得了显著提升。

sentences.en: For example, on the SVHN dataset, FedUSD improves 6.74\% to 30.82\% which is higher than others with Dirichlet coefficient $\alpha=0.01$.
sentences.zh: 例如，在 SVHN 数据集上，FedUSD 将准确率从 6.74\% 提升到 30.82\%，在狄利克雷系数 $\alpha=0.01$ 时高于其他方法。

title_en: FedVeer: Self-Adaptive Skew Estimation for Robust Federated Learning
title_zh: FedVeer：通过自适应偏斜估计实现鲁棒联邦学习

sentences.en: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative model training across decentralized clients, but its performance often degrades under non-IID data distributions, particularly in the presence of data skew.
sentences.zh: 联邦学习（FL）支持跨去中心化客户端的协作模型训练，但其性能在非 IID 数据分布下往往会下降，尤其是在存在数据偏斜的情况下。

sentences.en: Existing approaches mitigate this issue by estimating client skew via kernel density estimation over neighboring model updates, which preserves privacy and reduces communication costs.
sentences.zh: 现有方法通过对邻近模型更新的核密度估计来估计客户端偏斜，从而缓解这一问题，这既保护隐私又降低通信成本。

sentences.en: However, such approaches suffer from two fundamental limitations: bias toward skewed majority clients due to fixed neighborhood structures, and vulnerability to noise-induced perturbation in kernel space.
sentences.zh: 然而，这类方法存在两个根本局限：由于固定的邻域结构而偏向偏斜的多数客户端，以及在核空间中对噪声诱导扰动的脆弱性。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose FedVeer, a skew-aware FL framework based on self-adaptive kernel density estimation with k-free neighborhoods.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出 FedVeer，一个基于带无 k 邻域的自适应核密度估计的偏斜感知 FL 框架。

sentences.en: FedVeer dynamically determines the neighborhood size via max-margin learning to mitigate majority-client bias, and further incorporates Kalman filtering to stabilize margin estimation under noisy updates, with a high-probability theoretical guarantee on margin deviation.
sentences.zh: FedVeer 通过最大间隔学习动态确定邻域大小，以缓解多数客户端偏差，并进一步引入卡尔曼滤波，在带噪更新下稳定间隔估计，同时为间隔偏差提供高概率的理论保证。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on realworld datasets demonstrate that FedVeer consistently outperforms four baselines, achieving up to 6.36% accuracy improvement and reducing noiseinduced degradation by up to 6.01%.
sentences.zh: 在真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，FedVeer 持续优于四个基线，准确率提升最高达 6.36%，对噪声诱导的性能下降减少最高达 6.01%。

title_en: Feedback Control for Multi-Objective Graph Self-Supervision
title_zh: 多目标图自监督的反馈控制

sentences.en: Can multi-task self-supervised learning on graphs be coordinated without the usual tug-of-war between objectives?
sentences.zh: 图上的多任务自监督学习能否在不常见的目标间“拔河”的情形下实现协调？

sentences.en: Graph self-supervised learning (SSL) offers a growing toolbox of pretext objectives—mutual information, reconstruction, contrastive learning—yet combining them reliably remains a challenge due to objective interference and training instability.
sentences.zh: 图自监督学习（SSL）提供了日益丰富的预文本目标工具箱——互信息、重建、对比学习——但由于目标干扰与训练不稳定，可靠地将它们组合起来仍是一大挑战。

sentences.en: Most multi-pretext pipelines use per-update mixing, forcing every parameter update to be a compromise, leading to three failure modes: Disagreement (conflict-induced negative transfer), Drift (nonstationary objective utility), and Drought (hidden starvation of underserved objectives).
sentences.zh: 大多数多预文本流水线使用逐更新混合，迫使每次参数更新都成为折中，从而导致三种失效模式：分歧（冲突引起的负迁移）、漂移（非平稳的目标效用）与枯竭（欠服务目标被隐藏饿死）。

sentences.en: We argue that coordination is fundamentally a temporal allocation problem: deciding when each objective receives optimization budget, not merely how to weigh them.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，协调实质上是一个时间分配问题：决定每个目标在何时获得优化预算，而不仅仅是确定如何对它们加权。

sentences.en: We introduce ControlG, a control-theoretic framework that recasts multi-objective graph SSL as feedback-controlled temporal allocation by estimating per-objective difficulty and pairwise antagonism, planning target budgets via a Pareto-aware log-hypervolume planner, and scheduling with a Proportional–Integral–Derivative (PID) controller.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 ControlG，一个控制论框架，它通过估计每个目标的难度与两两对抗性，将多目标图 SSL 重构为反馈控制的时间分配问题；通过一个 Pareto 感知的对数超体积规划器来规划目标预算；并利用比例-积分-微分（PID）控制器进行调度。

sentences.en: Across 9 datasets, ControlG consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, while producing an auditable schedule that reveals which objectives drove learning.
sentences.zh: 在 9 个数据集上，ControlG 持续优于最先进的基线，同时生成一个可审计的调度，揭示出哪些目标驱动了学习。

title_en: FeRA: Frequency-Energy Constrained Routing for Effective Diffusion Adaptation Fine-Tuning
title_zh: FeRA：频率–能量约束路由，实现有效扩散适配微调

sentences.en: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in generative modeling, yet how to effectively adapting large pretrained models to new tasks remains challenging.
sentences.zh: 扩散模型在生成式建模中取得了显著成功，然而如何有效地将大型预训练模型适配到新任务仍然具有挑战性。

sentences.en: We revisit the reconstruction behavior of diffusion models during denoising to unveil the underlying frequency–energy mechanism governing this process.
sentences.zh: 我们重新审视扩散模型在去噪过程中的重建行为，以揭示支配这一过程的底层频率-能量机制。

sentences.en: Building upon this observation, we propose \textbf{FeRA}, a frequency-driven fine-tuning framework that aligns parameter updates with the intrinsic frequency–energy progression of diffusion.
sentences.zh: 基于这一观察，我们提出 \textbf{FeRA}，一个频率驱动的微调框架，使参数更新与扩散内在的频率-能量推进过程相对齐。

sentences.en: FeRA establishes a comprehensive frequency–energy framework for effective diffusion adaptation fine-tuning, comprising three synergistic components: \textit{(i)} a compact frequency–energy indicator that characterizes the latent’s bandwise energy distribution, \textit{(ii)} a soft frequency router that adaptively fuses multiple frequency-specific adapter experts, and \textit{(iii)} a frequency–energy consistency regularization that stabilizes diffusion optimization and ensures coherent adaptation across bands.
sentences.zh: FeRA 为有效的扩散适配微调建立了一个全面的频率-能量框架，包含三个协同组件：\textit{(i)} 一个紧凑的频率-能量指示器，描述潜变量的带间能量分布；\textit{(ii)} 一个软频率路由器，自适应地融合多个频率特异的适配器专家；\textit{(iii)} 一个频率-能量一致性正则化，稳定扩散优化并确保跨频带的连贯适配。

sentences.en: Routing operates in both training and inference, with inference-time routing dynamically determined by the latent frequency energy.
sentences.zh: 路由在训练与推断中都会运作，推断时的路由由潜变量频率能量动态确定。

sentences.en: It integrates seamlessly with adapter-based tuning schemes and generalizes well across diffusion backbones and resolutions.
sentences.zh: 它可以与基于适配器的调优方案无缝集成，并在不同扩散骨干网络与分辨率下良好泛化。

sentences.en: By aligning adaptation with the frequency–energy mechanism, \textbf{FeRA} provides a simple, stable, and compatible paradigm for effective and robust diffusion model adaptation.
sentences.zh: 通过将适配与频率-能量机制对齐，\textbf{FeRA} 为有效且稳健的扩散模型适配提供了一种简单、稳定且兼容的范式。

sentences.en: Codes will be made publicly available.
sentences.zh: 代码将公开发布。

authors.institution: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China

title_en: Few-Shot Design Optimization by Exploiting Auxiliary Information
title_zh: 通过利用辅助信息进行少样本设计优化

sentences.en: Many real-world design problems involve optimizing an expensive black-box function $f(x)$, for which Bayesian Optimization is a sample-efficient framework.
sentences.zh: 许多现实世界的设计问题都涉及优化一个昂贵的黑盒函数 $f(x)$，而贝叶斯优化是这一场景下的一种样本高效框架。

sentences.en: However, while the basic black-box setting returns a scalar reward, real-world experiments often generate a wealth of useful information.
sentences.zh: 然而，虽然基本的黑盒设定返回一个标量奖励，现实世界的实验往往会产生大量有用的信息。

sentences.en: We introduce a new setting where an experiment generates high-dimensional auxiliary information $h(x)$ along with $f(x)$; moreover, a history of relevant, previously-solved tasks is available for accelerating optimization.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一种新的设定，其中一次实验会随 $f(x)$ 一起生成高维辅助信息 $h(x)$；此外，还可以利用一段相关的、先前已解决问题的历史来加速优化。

sentences.en: We develop a novel method based on a neural model which predicts $f(x)$ for unseen designs given a few-shot context containing observations of $h(x)$.
sentences.zh: 我们开发一种基于神经模型的新方法，在给定包含 $h(x)$ 观测的少样本上下文中，预测未见设计的 $f(x)$。

sentences.en: We evaluate our method on two challenging domains, robotic hardware design and hyperparameter tuning.
sentences.zh: 我们在机器人硬件设计与超参数调优两个具有挑战性的领域评估我们的方法。

sentences.en: On both domains, our method achieves improved few-shot prediction and faster design optimization, outperforming several multi-task optimization methods.
sentences.zh: 在这两个领域中，我们的方法都实现了改进的少样本预测与更快的设计优化，优于多种多任务优化方法。

authors.institution: Department of Computer Science, Columbia University

title_en: FG-CLIP 2: A Bilingual Fine-grained Vision-Language Alignment Model
title_zh: FG-CLIP 2：双语细粒度视觉语言对齐模型

sentences.en: Fine-grained vision-language understanding requires precise alignment between visual content and linguistic descriptions, a capability that remains limited in current models, particularly in non-English settings.
sentences.zh: 细粒度视觉-语言理解要求视觉内容与语言描述之间的精确对齐，这一能力在当前模型中仍然有限，尤其是在非英语环境中。

sentences.en: While models like CLIP perform well on global alignment, they often struggle to capture fine-grained details in object attributes, spatial relations, and linguistic expressions, with limited support for bilingual comprehension.
sentences.zh: 虽然 CLIP 等模型在全局对齐上表现良好，但它们往往难以捕获对象属性、空间关系与语言表达式中的细粒度细节，且对双语理解的支持有限。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we introduce FG-CLIP 2, a bilingual vision-language model designed to advance fine-grained alignment for both English and Chinese.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们引入 FG-CLIP 2，一个专为同时推进英语与中文细粒度对齐而设计的双语视觉-语言模型。

sentences.en: Our approach leverages rich fine-grained supervision, including region-text matching and long-caption modeling, alongside multiple discriminative objectives.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法利用了丰富的细粒度监督，包括区域-文本匹配与长字幕建模，以及多个判别式目标。

sentences.en: We further introduce the Textual Intra-modal Contrastive (TIC) loss to better distinguish semantically similar captions.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步引入文本模态内对比（TIC）损失，以更好地区分语义相似的字幕。

sentences.en: Trained on a carefully curated mixture of large-scale English and Chinese data, including a newly released 12M Chinese region-text dataset, FG-CLIP 2 achieves powerful bilingual performance.
sentences.zh: FG-CLIP 2 在精心策划的大规模中英数据混合上训练，其中包括一个新发布的 1200 万条中文区域-文本数据集，从而实现了强大的双语性能。

sentences.en: To enable rigorous evaluation, we present a new benchmark for Chinese multimodal understanding, featuring long-caption retrieval and bounding box classification.
sentences.zh: 为支持严格的评估，我们为中文多模态理解提出了一个新基准，具有长字幕检索与边界框分类的特点。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on 29 datasets across 8 tasks show that FG-CLIP 2 outperforms existing methods, achieving state-of-the-art results in both languages.
sentences.zh: 在覆盖 8 个任务、29 个数据集上的大量实验表明，FG-CLIP 2 优于现有方法，在两种语言上都取得了最先进的结果。

sentences.en: We release the model, code, and benchmark to facilitate future research on bilingual fine-grained vision-language alignment.
sentences.zh: 我们发布模型、代码与基准，以促进关于双语细粒度视觉-语言对齐的未来研究。

title_en: FIBER: A Differentially Private Optimizer with Filter-Aware Innovation Bias Correction
title_zh: FIBER：具有滤波器感知新息偏差校正的差分隐私优化器

sentences.en: Differentially private (DP) training protects individual examples by adding noise to gradients, but the injected noise interacts nontrivially with adaptive optimizers.
sentences.zh: 差分隐私（DP）训练通过向梯度添加噪声来保护单个样本，但注入的噪声与自适应优化器之间的交互并不平凡。

sentences.en: Recent DP methods temporally filter privatized gradients to reduce variance; however, filtering also changes the DP noise statistics seen by AdamW’s second-moment accumulator.
sentences.zh: 近期的 DP 方法对隐私化梯度进行时序滤波以降低方差；然而，滤波也会改变 AdamW 二阶矩累加器所看到的 DP 噪声统计量。

sentences.en: As a result, bias corrections derived for unfiltered DP noise (e.g., subtracting $\sigma_w^2$) can become miscalibrated when filtering is present.
sentences.zh: 因此，为未滤波 DP 噪声推导的偏差校正（例如减去 $\sigma_w^2$）在存在滤波时会变得不当标定。

sentences.en: We propose FIBER, a DP optimizer designed for temporally filtered privatized gradients.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 FIBER，一个专为时序滤波的隐私化梯度设计的 DP 优化器。

sentences.en: FIBER (i) performs denoising in innovation space by filtering the residual stream and integrating it to form the filtered gradient estimate, (ii) decouples the two-point observation geometry from the innovation gain to enable independent tuning, and (iii) introduces a filter-aware second-moment calibration that subtracts the attenuated DP noise contribution $A(\omega)\sigma_w^2$, where $A(\omega)$ is derived in closed form for the innovation filter and can be computed for general stable linear filters.
sentences.zh: FIBER (i) 在新颖空间中进行去噪，对残差流进行滤波并将其积分形成滤波梯度估计；(ii) 将两点观测几何与新颖增益解耦，从而支持独立调优；(iii) 引入一种滤波感知的二阶矩校准，它减去衰减的 DP 噪声贡献 $A(\omega)\sigma_w^2$，其中 $A(\omega)$ 为新颖滤波导出了闭式解，并可对一般稳定线性滤波器计算。

sentences.en: Across vision and language benchmarks, FIBER consistently demonstrates substantial improvements in the performance of DP optimizers, surpassing state-of-the-art results under equivalent privacy constraints on multiple tasks.
sentences.zh: 在视觉与语言基准上，FIBER 持续展现出 DP 优化器性能的显著提升，在多个任务上以等效隐私约束超越了最先进的结果。

title_en: FIDIA: Function-Informed Sequence Design via Inference-Aligned Policy Optimization
title_zh: FIDIA：通过推理对齐策略优化实现功能信息序列设计

sentences.en: Computational protein design typically employs a sequential workflow of structure generation followed by sequence (re)design.
sentences.zh: 计算蛋白质设计通常采用先进行结构生成、再进行序列（重）设计的序贯工作流。

sentences.en: While structure generators can be explicitly conditioned on functional objectives, inverse folding models are constrained by their function-agnostic nature and sequence-structure degeneracy.
sentences.zh: 虽然结构生成器可以显式地以功能目标为条件，但逆向折叠模型受限于其功能无关的特性以及序列-结构简并性。

sentences.en: More critically, the associated training objectives do not account for the *Best-of-N* (BoN) inference protocol, resulting in a fundamental training-inference misalignment.
sentences.zh: 更关键的是，相关的训练目标并未考虑 *Best-of-N*（BoN）推断协议，从而导致根本性的训练-推断错位。

sentences.en: Here, we propose FIDIA, a reinforcement learning framework that enables **F**unction-**I**nformed sequence **D**esign via **I**nference-**A**ligned policy optimization.
sentences.zh: 在此，我们提出 FIDIA，一个强化学习框架，通过推断对齐的策略优化实现 **功能知情**的序列设计。

sentences.en: Specifically, FIDIA integrates functional constraints into composite rewards and explicitly optimize the induced policy under BoN toward high-fitness sequence regions.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，FIDIA 将功能约束整合到复合奖励中，并在 BoN 下显式优化所诱导的策略，使其朝高适应度序列区域前进。

sentences.en: We achieve this via a grounded gradient estimator that directly maximizes the expected maximum reward.
sentences.zh: 我们通过一个有根据的梯度估计器实现这一点，它直接最大化期望最大奖励。

sentences.en: FIDIA consistently outperforms both standard and RL-optimized baselines in success rate and precision on a general motif scaffolding benchmark.
sentences.zh: 在一般性模体支架基准上，FIDIA 在成功率与精确率方面持续优于标准基线与 RL 优化基线。

sentences.en: Further experiments on realworld cases including vaccine and affinity-enhancing enzyme design validate FIDIA’s efficacy in complex therapeutic and biocatalytic contexts.
sentences.zh: 在包括疫苗与亲和力增强酶设计在内的真实世界案例上的进一步实验，验证了 FIDIA 在复杂治疗与生物催化场景中的有效性。
