title_en: FiGuRO: Intrinsic Dimension Estimation for Multi-Modal Data
title_zh: FiGuRO：多模态数据的内在维度估计

sentences.en: Determining the complexity, or Intrinsic Dimension (ID), of data is fundamental to efficient and interpretable representation learning.
sentences.zh: 确定数据的复杂度，即内在维度（ID），是实现高效且可解释表示学习的基础。

sentences.en: This is particularly challenging in multi-modal settings when trying to learn disentangled representations for shared and private information.
sentences.zh: 在多模态设定中，当试图为共享信息与私有信息学习解缠表示时，这一点尤其具有挑战性。

sentences.en: Existing techniques leave a critical gap: they are often static, uni-modal, or in the case of contrastive methods, adapt only to the shared ID implicitly.
sentences.zh: 现有技术存在一个关键空白：它们往往呈静态、单一模态，或者就对比方法而言，仅能隐式地适应共享的 ID。

sentences.en: We introduce Fidelity-Guided Rank Optimization (FiGuRO), a framework for approximating the ID of uni- and multi-modal data under constraints of model capacity and hyperparameters.
sentences.zh: 我们引入保真度引导的秩优化（FiGuRO），一个在模型容量与超参数约束下近似单模态与多模态数据 ID 的框架。

sentences.en: FiGuRO learns the dimensions of low-rank projections using truncated singular value decomposition and an algorithm that determines when to reduce or increase dimension and in which latent space.
sentences.zh: FiGuRO 利用截断奇异值分解以及一种决定何时降低或升高维度、以及在哪个潜空间中进行的算法，来学习低秩投影的维度。

sentences.en: Disentanglement of shared and private information arises as an emergent property of this optimization, eliminating the need for complex auxiliary loss functions.
sentences.zh: 共享与私有信息的解缠作为这一优化的涌现性质而出现，从而消除了对复杂辅助损失函数的需要。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that FiGuRO outperforms existing ID estimation techniques and is more robust to hyperparameter changes.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，FiGuRO 优于现有的 ID 估计技术，并且对超参数变化更具鲁棒性。

sentences.en: Across simulations and real-world data, FiGuRO captures distinct ID scales and varying subspace ratios, and decomposes shared and private information successfully.
sentences.zh: 在仿真与真实世界数据上，FiGuRO 捕获了不同的 ID 尺度与变化的子空间比例，并成功地分解了共享与私有信息。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we show that FiGuRO can be applied to modern uni-modal pretrained models, enabling efficient, post-hoc disentanglement of multi-modal representations.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们表明 FiGuRO 可以应用于现代单模态预训练模型，从而实现对多模态表示的高效、事后解缠。

title_en: Find, Fix, Reason: Context Repair for Video Reasoning
title_zh: 查找、修复、推理：视频推理的上下文修复

sentences.en: Reinforcement learning has advanced video reasoning in large multi-modal models, yet dominant pipelines either rely on on-policy self-exploration, which plateaus at the model’s knowledge boundary, or hybrid replay that mixes policies and demands careful regularization.
sentences.zh: 强化学习推动了大型多模态模型中的视频推理，但占主导地位的流水线要么依赖在模型的知识边界处趋于平缓的在线自探索，要么依赖混合多种策略并需要仔细正则化的混合重放。

sentences.en: Dynamic context methods zoom into focused evidence but often require curated pretraining and two-stage tuning, and their context remains bounded by a small model’s capability.
sentences.zh: 动态上下文方法会聚焦于关键证据，但往往需要精心策划的预训练与两阶段调优，且其上下文仍受限于小模型的能力。

sentences.en: In contrast, larger models excel at instruction following and multi-modal understanding, can supply richer context to smaller models, and rapidly zoom in on target regions via simple tools.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，更大的模型擅长指令遵循与多模态理解，能够为较小的模型提供更丰富的上下文，并通过简单的工具迅速聚焦目标区域。

sentences.en: Building on this capability, we introduce an observation-level intervention: a frozen, tool-integrated teacher identifies the missing spatiotemporal dependency and provides a minimal evidence patch (e.g., timestamps, regions etc.) from the original video while the question remains unchanged.
sentences.zh: 基于这一能力，我们引入一种观察层级的干预：一个冻结的、集成工具的老师识别出缺失的时空依赖，并从原始视频中提供最小证据补丁（例如时间戳、区域等），同时保持问题不变。

sentences.en: The student answers again with the added context, and training updates with a chosen-rollout scheme integrated into Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO).
sentences.zh: 学生带上新增上下文再次作答，训练则采用集成到组相对策略优化（GRPO）中的选定 rollout 方案进行更新。

sentences.en: We further propose a Robust Improvement Reward (RIR) that aligns optimization with two goals: outcome validity through correct answers and dependency alignment through rationales that reflect the cited evidence.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步提出稳健改进奖励（RIR），将优化与两个目标对齐：通过正确答案实现结果有效性，以及通过反映所引用证据的推理实现依赖对齐。

sentences.en: Advantages are group-normalized across the batch, preserving on-policy exploration while directing it along causally meaningful directions with minimal changes to the training stack.
sentences.zh: 优势在批次内按组归一化，在保留在线探索的同时，以对训练栈的最小改动将其导向因果上有意义的方向。

sentences.en: Experiments on various related benchmarks show consistent accuracy gains and strong generalization.
sentences.zh: 在多个相关基准上的实验显示出一致的准确率提升与强大的泛化能力。

sentences.en: Project page is available at https://jethrojames.github.io/FFR/.
sentences.zh: 项目页面可在 https://jethrojames.github.io/FFR/ 获取。

authors.institution: Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences

title_en: Finding Differentially Private Second Order Stationary Points in Stochastic Minimax Optimization
title_zh: 在随机极小极大优化中寻找差分隐私二阶驻点

sentences.en: We provide the first study of the problem of finding differentially private (DP) second-order stationary points (SOSP) in  stochastic (non-convex) minimax optimization.
sentences.zh: 我们首次研究在随机（非凸）极小极大优化中寻找差分隐私（DP）二阶驻点（SOSP）的问题。

sentences.en: Existing literature either focuses only on first-order stationary points for minimax problems or on SOSP for classical stochastic minimization problems.
sentences.zh: 现有文献要么只关注极小极大问题的一阶驻点，要么只关注经典随机最小化问题的 SOSP。

sentences.en: This work provides, for the first time, a unified and detailed treatment of both empirical  and population risks.
sentences.zh: 这项工作首次对经验风险与总体风险进行了统一而详尽的处理。

sentences.en: Specifically, we propose a purely first-order method that combines a nested gradient descent--ascent scheme with SPIDER-style variance reduction and Gaussian perturbations to ensure privacy.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们提出一种纯一阶方法，将嵌套梯度下降-上升方案与 SPIDER 式方差缩减以及高斯扰动相结合，以确保隐私。

sentences.en: A key technical device is a block-wise ($q$-period) analysis that controls the accumulation of stochastic variance and privacy noise without summing over the full iteration horizon, yielding a unified treatment of both empirical-risk and population formulations.
sentences.zh: 一个关键的技术手段是分块（$q$ 周期）分析，在不累加完整迭代时域的情况下控制随机方差与隐私噪声的累积，从而实现对经验风险与总体风险公式的统一处理。

sentences.en: Under standard smoothness, Hessian-Lipschitzness, and strong concavity assumptions, we establish high-probability guarantees for reaching an $(\alpha,\sqrt{\rho_\Phi \alpha})$-approximate second-order stationary point with $\alpha = \mathcal{O}(  (\frac{\sqrt{d}}{n\varepsilon})^{2/3})$ for empirical risk objectives and $\mathcal{O}(\frac{1}{n^{1/3}} + (\frac{\sqrt{d}}{n\varepsilon})^{1/2})$ for population objectives, matching the best known rates for private first-order stationarity.
sentences.zh: 在标准光滑性、Hessian-Lipschitz 性与强凹性假设下，我们建立了达到 $(\alpha,\sqrt{\rho_\Phi \alpha})$ 近似二阶驻点的高概率保证，其中 $\alpha = \mathcal{O}((\frac{\sqrt{d}}{n\varepsilon})^{2/3})$（针对经验风险目标），以及 $\mathcal{O}(\frac{1}{n^{1/3}} + (\frac{\sqrt{d}}{n\varepsilon})^{1/2})$（针对总体目标），与私有一阶驻点的已知最优速率相匹配。

authors.institution: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)

title_en: Finding DoRI: Discovery of Retained Images in Diffusion Models
title_zh: 寻找 DoRI：发现扩散模型中保留的图像

sentences.en: Text-to-image diffusion models (DMs) have achieved remarkable success in image generation.
sentences.zh: 文本到图像扩散模型（DM）在图像生成方面取得了显著成功。

sentences.en: However, concerns about data privacy and intellectual property remain due to their potential to inadvertently memorize and replicate training data.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于其可能无意中记忆并复制训练数据，数据隐私与知识产权方面的担忧依然存在。

sentences.en: Recent mitigation efforts have focused on identifying and pruning weights responsible for triggering verbatim training data replication, based on the assumption that memorization can be localized.
sentences.zh: 近期的缓解工作聚焦于识别并剪枝负责触发逐字训练数据复制的权重，其假设是记忆可以被定位。

sentences.en: We challenge this assumption and demonstrate that, even after such pruning, small perturbations to the text embeddings of previously mitigated prompts can re-trigger data replication, revealing the fragility of such methods.
sentences.zh: 我们挑战这一假设，并证明即使经过此类剪枝，对先前已被缓解提示的文本嵌入施加微小扰动，也能重新触发数据复制，从而揭示这类方法的脆弱性。

sentences.en: Our further analysis then provides multiple indications that memorization is indeed *not* inherently local: (1) replication triggers for memorized images are distributed throughout text embedding space; (2) embeddings yielding the same replicated image produce divergent model activations; and (3) different pruning methods identify inconsistent sets of memorization-related weights for the same image.
sentences.zh: 我们的进一步分析随后提供了多项证据表明记忆确实 *并非* 本质上是局部的：(1) 记忆图像的复制触发器分布于整个文本嵌入空间；(2) 产生同一复制图像的嵌入会产生分化的模型激活；且 (3) 不同剪枝方法为同一图像识别出不一致的记忆相关权重集。

sentences.en: Finally, we show that bypassing the locality assumption enables more robust mitigation through adversarial fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们证明绕过局部性假设可以通过对抗性微调实现更稳健的缓解。

sentences.en: These findings provide new insights into the fundamental nature of memorization in text-to-image DMs and inform the future development of more reliable mitigation methods against DM memorization.
sentences.zh: 这些发现为文本到图像 DM 中记忆的根本本质提供了新洞见，并为未来开发更可靠的、针对 DM 记忆的缓解方法提供了信息。

title_en: Finding Most Influential Sets
title_zh: 寻找最具影响力的集合

sentences.en: Identifying _most influential sets_ (MIS) – size-$k$ subsets whose removal maximally changes a target estimand – is typically infeasible because it requires searching over $n$ choose $k$ subsets.
sentences.zh: 识别 _最具影响力集合_（MIS）——删除后能最大程度改变目标估计量的规模为 $k$ 的子集——通常不可行，因为它需要在 $n$ 个元素中搜索 $k$ 个元素的全部子集组合。

sentences.en: For estimands with linear-fractional leave-set-out effects, we show that MIS selection reduces to a one-parameter sequence of top-$k$ problems.
sentences.zh: 对于具有线性分数留集效应的估计量，我们表明 MIS 选择可归结为单参数序列的 top-$k$ 问题。

sentences.en: Dinkelbach's method yields an algorithm with $\mathcal{O}(n)$ cost per iteration and finite termination.
sentences.zh: Dinkelbach 方法给出一种每迭代代价为 $\mathcal{O}(n)$ 且能有限终止的算法。

sentences.en: For fixed residualized inputs, the algorithm returns a globally optimal set for the univariate ratio objective, including the oracle-residualized partial linear model.
sentences.zh: 对于固定残差化的输入，该算法可为单变量比率目标返回全局最优集合，包括预言机残差化的部分线性模型。

sentences.en: With estimated nuisance functions, uniform denominator and generated-score stability imply approximation to the first-order oracle orthogonal-score objective; exact set recovery follows under a separation condition.
sentences.zh: 在估计出干扰函数的情况下，均匀分母与生成的得分稳定性蕴含对一阶预言机正交得分目标的逼近；在分离条件下可精确恢复集合。

sentences.en: Simulations and applications show that the method recovers exact MIS that were previously computationally inaccessible.
sentences.zh: 仿真与应用表明，该方法能够恢复此前计算上难以企及的精确 MIS。

title_en: Finding Stationary Points by Comparisons
title_zh: 通过比较寻找驻点

sentences.en: We study the problem of finding stationary points of non-convex functions when access to the objective is provided only through a comparison oracle that, given two points, outputs which has the larger function value.
sentences.zh: 我们研究在仅能通过比较预言机访问目标函数时寻找非凸函数驻点的问题，该预言机给定两个点，输出哪个点的函数值更大。

sentences.en: For a twice differentiable $f:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$ with Lipschitz gradient and Hessian, we develop an algorithm that outputs an $\epsilon$-stationary point using $\widetilde O(n^2/\epsilon^{1.5})$ queries.
sentences.zh: 对于具有 Lipschitz 梯度与 Hessian 的二阶可微 $f:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$，我们开发一种算法，使用 $\widetilde O(n^2/\epsilon^{1.5})$ 次查询输出一个 $\epsilon$-驻点。

sentences.en: Our approach uses a subroutine that estimates the normalized Hessian to accuracy $\delta$ using $\widetilde O(n^2\log(1/\delta))$ queries.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法使用一个子例程，用 $\widetilde O(n^2\log(1/\delta))$ 次查询将归一化 Hessian 估计到 $\delta$ 精度。

sentences.en: We further study this problem with a quantum comparison oracle model where queries can be made in superpositions, and develop the first quantum algorithm that finds an $\epsilon$-stationary point, which takes $\widetilde O(n/\epsilon^{1.5})$ queries.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步在量子比较预言机模型下研究该问题，其中查询可以在叠加态中进行，并开发出第一个能够找到 $\epsilon$-驻点的量子算法，它需要 $\widetilde O(n/\epsilon^{1.5})$ 次查询。

title_en: Finding the Correct Visual Evidence Without Forgetting: Mitigating Hallucination in LVLMs via Inter-Layer Visual Attention Discrepancy
title_zh: 找到正确视觉证据而不遗忘：通过层间视觉注意力差异缓解大型视觉语言模型幻觉

sentences.en: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have shown remarkable performance on a wide range of vision-language tasks.
sentences.zh: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）在广泛的视觉-语言任务上展现出了卓越的性能。

sentences.en: Despite this progress, they are still prone to hallucination, generating responses that are inconsistent with visual content.
sentences.zh: 尽管取得了这样的进展，它们仍然容易产生幻觉，生成与视觉内容不一致的回应。

sentences.en: In this work, we find that LVLMs tend to hallucinate when they pay insufficient attention to the correct visual evidence and gradually forget it during the generation process.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们发现 LVLM 往往在对正确的视觉证据注意力不足、并在生成过程中逐渐遗忘它时产生幻觉。

sentences.en: We empirically find that although LVLMs overall attend insufficiently to visual evidence, they exhibit sensitivity to the correct visual evidence in specific layers, with notable inter-layer discrepancy.
sentences.zh: 我们实证发现，尽管 LVLM 总体上对视觉证据的注意力不足，但它们在特定层中对正确的视觉证据表现出敏感性，具有显著的层间差异。

sentences.en: Motivated by this observation, we propose a novel hallucination mitigation method that enhances visual evidence based on **I**nter-**L**ayer **V**isual **A**ttention **D**iscrepancy (**ILVAD**).
sentences.zh: 受这一观察启发，我们提出一种新颖的幻觉缓解方法，它基于 **层间视觉注意力差异**（**ILVAD**）增强视觉证据。

sentences.en: Specifically, we obtain the attention weights from early generated tokens to visual tokens across layers and identify the tokens that are repeatedly activated as visual evidence, forming a saliency map.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们获取跨层的、从早期生成 token 到视觉 token 的注意力权重，并识别出被反复激活作为视觉证据的 token，从而形成一张显著性图。

sentences.en: We then enhance attention to visual evidence during generation through the saliency map to reduce visual forgetting.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们在生成过程中通过显著性图增强对视觉证据的注意力，以减少视觉遗忘。

sentences.en: In addition, we leverage the saliency map to obtain attention scores of generated text to visual evidence, in order to select and emphasize text tokens that are strongly grounded in visual evidence.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们利用显著性图获得生成文本对视觉证据的注意力分数，以选择并强调与视觉证据紧密根基的文本 token。

sentences.en: Our method is training-free and plug-and-play.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法免训练且即插即用。

sentences.en: Multiple benchmark evaluations conducted on five recently released models show that our method can consistently mitigate hallucinations in different LVLMs over various architectures.
sentences.zh: 在五个最近发布的模型上进行的多项基准评估表明，我们的方法能够在不同架构的各种 LVLM 上持续缓解幻觉。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/ytx-ML/ILVAD.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/ytx-ML/ILVAD 获取。

title_en: Finding the Minimal Parameter Budget for Implicit Reasoning: A Data Complexity Driven Scaling Law for Language Models
title_zh: 寻找隐式推理的最小参数预算：数据复杂度驱动的语言模型缩放定律

sentences.en: Reasoning is a core capability of language models (LMs), yet it remains unclear how much model capacity is necessary to support reasoning during pretraining.
sentences.zh: 推理是语言模型（LM）是一项核心竞争力，但在预训练期间需要多大的模型容量来支持推理，目前仍不清楚。

sentences.en: In this work, we study the minimal parameter budget required for implicit reasoning, defined as the ability to infer new facts from learned knowledge without explicit chain-of-thought supervision.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们研究隐式推理所需的最小参数预算，隐式推理定义为无需显式思维链监督即可从已学知识推断出新事实的能力。

sentences.en: To isolate this phenomenon, we pretrain LMs from scratch in a controlled synthetic environment that mimics the structure and distribution of real-world knowledge graphs, and evaluate their ability to complete missing edges via multi-hop inference.
sentences.zh: 为分离这一现象，我们在一个模仿真实世界知识图谱结构与分布的受控综合环境中，从零开始预训练 LM，并评估它们通过多跳推理补全缺失边的能力。

sentences.en: From both a theoretical and an empirical perspective, we identify a scaling law linking this optimal parameter budget to a graph search entropy measure.
sentences.zh: 从理论与实证两个角度，我们识别出一条将这一最优参数预算与图搜索熵测度联系起来的缩放定律。

sentences.en: Across a wide range of model sizes, training steps, and graph complexities, we show that an optimally sized language model can reliably reason over approximately 0.008 bits of information per parameter at most.
sentences.zh: 在广泛的模型规模、训练步数与图复杂度范围内，我们表明最优规模的语言模型至多能在每个参数约 0.008 比特的信息上可靠地推理。

sentences.en: Our results characterize the minimal sufficient capacity for implicit reasoning during pretraining.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果刻画了预训练期间隐式推理所需的最小充分容量。

sentences.en: Our findings provide principled guidance for matching model size to data complexity and offer new insights into the scaling behavior of reasoning in large language models.
sentences.zh: 我们的发现为将模型规模与数据复杂度相匹配提供了有原则的指导，并为大语言模型中推理的缩放行为提供了新的洞见。

title_en: Fine-grained Analysis of Brain-LLM Alignment through Input Attribution
title_zh: 通过输入归因细粒度分析大脑与大语言模型的对齐

sentences.en: Understanding the alignment between large language models (LLMs) and human brain activity can reveal computational principles underlying language processing.
sentences.zh: 理解大语言模型（LLM）与人类大脑活动之间的对齐，可以揭示语言处理背后的计算原理。

sentences.en: This work describes a pipeline to apply attribution methods to the brain-LLM alignment setting to identify the specific words most important for this alignment.
sentences.zh: 这项工作描述了一个将归因方法应用于大脑-LLM 对齐设定的流水线，以识别对该对齐最重要的特定单词。

sentences.en: As a case study, we leverage it to study a contentious research question about brain-LLM alignment: the relationship between brain alignment (BA) and next-word prediction (NWP).
sentences.zh: 作为案例研究，我们利用它来研究一个关于大脑-LLM 对齐的有争议研究问题：大脑对齐（BA）与下一个词预测（NWP）之间的关系。

sentences.en: Across two naturalistic fMRI datasets, we find that BA and NWP rely on largely distinct word subsets: NWP exhibits recency and primacy biases with a focus on syntax, while BA prioritizes semantic and discourse-level information with a more targeted recency effect.
sentences.zh: 在两个自然主义 fMRI 数据集上，我们发现 BA 与 NWP 依赖的单词子集大体不同：NWP 表现出近因与首因偏差，且聚焦于句法；而 BA 优先处理语义与话语层面的信息，并具有更具指向性的近因效应。

sentences.en: This work advances our understanding of how LLMs relate to human language processing and highlights differences in feature reliance between BA and NWP.
sentences.zh: 这项工作增进了我们对 LLM 与人类语言处理之间关系的理解，并凸显了 BA 与 NWP 在特征依赖上的差异。

sentences.en: Beyond this study, our attribution method can be broadly applied to explore the cognitive relevance of model predictions in diverse language processing tasks.
sentences.zh: 在本研究之外，我们的归因方法还可广泛用于探索多种语言处理任务中模型预测的认知相关性。

title_en: Fine-to-Coarse Fairness-Informed Multi-View Clustering
title_zh: 由细到粗的公平性信息多视图聚类

sentences.en: In multi-view clustering (MVC), conventional anchor learning based models implicitly assume a uniform distribution of anchors across clusters, which could lead to inferior representation, especially when clusters vary significantly in size, as larger clusters require more anchors so as to adequately capture their intrinsic structural complexity.
sentences.zh: 在多视图聚类（MVC）中，传统的基于锚点学习的模型隐含地假设锚点在簇间均匀分配，这可能导致较差的表示，尤其在簇的规模差异显著时——因为较大的簇需要更多的锚点，以充分捕获其内在的结构复杂度。

sentences.en: To alleviate this, we design a method termed FCFMVC that explicitly encourages proportional anchor allocation.
sentences.zh: 为缓解这一问题，我们设计了一种称为 FCFMVC 的方法，它显式地鼓励成比例的锚点分配。

sentences.en: To be specific, we transfer anchor allocation to discrete sample-cluster learning via bipartite graph bridge, and then backpropagate cluster state consisting of size and dispersion degree to guide anchor assignment.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们通过二部图桥梁将锚点分配转化为离散的样本-簇学习，然后反向传播由规模与离散程度构成的簇状态，以引导锚点分配。

sentences.en: This allows the model to integrate cluster cardinality awareness and structural compactness directly into anchor distribution.
sentences.zh: 这使得模型能够将簇基数意识与结构紧凑性直接整合到锚点分布中。

sentences.en: On the other hand, we regard anchors as pseudo-samples, introduce an anchor-cluster indicator matrix on each view, and directly constrain the number of anchors assigned to each cluster within a tolerance margin.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，我们将锚点视为伪样本，在每个视图上引入一个锚点-簇指示矩阵，并直接在容差范围内约束分配给每个簇的锚点数量。

sentences.en: These two paths are further coupled through anchor-sample label alignment, and collaboratively facilitate anchor generation from fine-grained (anchor-level) to coarse-grained (cluster-level) structures.
sentences.zh: 这两条路径进一步通过锚点-样本标签对齐相耦合，并协同促进从细粒度（锚点级）到粗粒度（簇级）结构的锚点生成。

sentences.en: Besides, the entire optimization operation with linear time and space cost makes FCFMVC well-scalable to large-scale tasks.
sentences.zh: 此外，整个优化过程具有线性的时间与空间成本，使 FCFMVC 能够良好地扩展到大规模任务。

sentences.en: Experiments on  datasets with diverse scales confirm the effectiveness of our FCFMVC.
sentences.zh: 在不同规模数据集上的实验证实了我们的 FCFMVC 的有效性。

topic: General Machine Learning->Transfer, Multitask and Meta-learning
title_en: Fine-Tune Once, Reuse Across Models: Bayesian Task-Update Factors and Approximations
title_zh: 微调一次，跨模型复用：贝叶斯任务更新因子及其近似

sentences.en: As pre-trained models evolve rapidly, transferring fine-tuning knowledge to updated models without retraining has become a critical challenge.
sentences.zh: 随着预训练模型快速演化，在无需重新训练的情况下将微调知识迁移到更新的模型已成为一项关键挑战。

sentences.en: Most existing methods reuse parameter updates, yet the same dataset can induce substantially different updates across base models due to mismatched local loss landscapes, making such transfer unstable.
sentences.zh: 现有的大多数方法复用参数更新，然而由于局部损失曲面的不匹配，相同的数据集在不同基础模型上可能引发显著不同的更新，从而使这种迁移不稳定。

sentences.en: We instead adopt a Bayesian-updating perspective: a base model defines a prior, while fine-tuning contributes a task-update factor that is prior-agnostic, thereby making it feasible to reuse the update across base models.
sentences.zh: 我们转而采用贝叶斯更新的视角：基础模型定义一个先验，而微调贡献一个与先验无关的任务更新因子，从而使得跨基础模型复用该更新成为可能。

sentences.en: Specifically, we formalize a reusable task-update factor by requiring *invariance across base models* and *a fixed-dimensional parameterization*.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们通过要求 *跨基础模型的不变性* 与 *固定维度的参数化* 来形式化一个可复用的任务更新因子。

sentences.en: Our main theoretical result shows that such reusable factors exist when the variational family is a half-space, and it is already maximal among convex families.
sentences.zh: 我们的主要理论结果表明，当变分族是半空间时，这样的可复用因子存在，并且它已经在一族凸族中达到最大。

sentences.en: In particular, an ideal regime arises when the priors and their Bayesian posteriors remain within a shared exponential family, as it always admits a reusable update factor.
sentences.zh: 特别地，当先验与其贝叶斯后验保持在同一个指数族内时，会出现一种理想情形，因为它总是允许一个可复用的更新因子。

sentences.en: Building on this existence, we propose ***B**ayesian Task Update **Transfer*** (*BTransfer*), which extracts a reusable task-update factor from a single fine-tuning run and applies it to a new prior.
sentences.zh: 基于这一存在性，我们提出 ***B**ayesian Task **Update** **Transfer***（*BTransfer*），它从单次微调运行中提取一个可复用的任务更新因子，并将其应用于新的先验。

sentences.en: For deep networks, we implement *BTransfer* with a ``lift–transfer–return'' pipeline: 1) lift model parameters to distributions;
sentences.zh: 对于深度网络，我们以“提升—迁移—返回”流水线实现 *BTransfer*：1) 将模型参数提升为分布；

sentences.en: 2) transfer the extracted task-update factor in the exponential family distributions; and 3) return the updated posterior distribution to parameter space.
sentences.zh: 2) 在指数族分布中迁移所提取的任务更新因子；3) 将更新后的后验分布返回到参数空间。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach effectively reuses fine-tuning knowledge across models without post-training.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，我们的方法能够在无需后训练的情况下跨模型有效复用微调知识。

title_en: Fine-Tuning Masked Diffusion for Provable Self-Correction
title_zh: 微调掩码扩散以实现可证明的自纠正

sentences.en: A natural desideratum for generative models is self-correction--detecting and revising low-quality tokens at inference.
sentences.zh: 生成模型的一个自然期望是自我修正——在推断时检测并修改低质量 token。

sentences.en: While Masked Diffusion Models (MDMs) have emerged as a promising approach for generative modeling in discrete spaces, their capacity for self-correction remains poorly understood.
sentences.zh: 虽然掩蔽扩散模型（MDM）已成为离散空间中生成建模的一种有前景的方法，但其自我修正能力仍缺乏深入理解。

sentences.en: Prior attempts to incorporate self-correction into MDMs either require overhauling MDM architectures/training or rely on imprecise proxies for token quality, limiting their applicability.
sentences.zh: 先前将自我修正纳入 MDM 的尝试要么需要彻底改造 MDM 的架构/训练，要么依赖对 token 质量不精确的替代度量，从而限制了其适用性。

sentences.en: Motivated by this, we introduce PRISM--Plug-in Remasking for Inference-time Self-correction of Masked Diffusions--a lightweight, model-agnostic approach that applies to any pretrained MDM.
sentences.zh: 受此启发，我们引入 PRISM——掩蔽扩散的即插即用重掩蔽实现推断时自我修正——一种轻量级、与模型无关的方法，适用于任何预训练 MDM。

sentences.en: Theoretically, PRISM defines a self-correction loss that provably learns per-token quality scores, without RL or a verifier.
sentences.zh: 在理论上，PRISM 定义一个可学习的自我修正损失，它为每个 token 学习质量分数，且可证明有效，无需 RL 或验证器。

sentences.en: These quality scores are computed in the same forward pass with MDM and used to detect low-quality tokens.
sentences.zh: 这些质量分数在 MDM 的同一前向传播中计算，并用于检测低质量 token。

sentences.en: Empirically, PRISM advances MDM inference across domains and scales: Sudoku; unconditional text (170M); and code with LLaDA (8B).
sentences.zh: 在实证上，PRISM 在多个领域与规模上推进了 MDM 推断：数独；无条件文本（170M）；以及使用 LLaDA（8B）的代码。

sentences.en: We open-source our codebase in https://github.com/SeunggeunKimkr/PRISM.
sentences.zh: 我们在 https://github.com/SeunggeunKimkr/PRISM 开源了我们的代码库。

authors.name: David Pan
authors.institution: The University of Texas at Austin

title_en: Fine-Tuning of Transformer models with Frames
title_zh: 利用框架系统微调 Transformer 模型

sentences.en: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) strategies such as Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) are effective solutions for fine-tuning large-scale pre-trained models; however, their memory requirements scales with the size of the model, $\mathcal{O}(dr)$, where $d$ is the model's hidden dimension and $r$ is the rank.
sentences.zh: 参数高效微调（PEFT）策略（如低秩适配（LoRA））是微调大规模预训练模型的有效方案；然而，它们的内存需求随模型规模按 $\mathcal{O}(dr)$ 增长，其中 $d$ 是模型的隐藏维度，$r$ 是秩。

sentences.en: Our proposal, FrameFT,  models the parameter update $\Delta W$ with a sparse coefficient matrix in a Fusion Frame basis.
sentences.zh: 我们的方案 FrameFT 在融合框架基（Fusion Frame）基中用稀疏系数矩阵对参数更新 $\Delta W$ 建模。

sentences.en: Fusion Frames can be generated algorithmically and shared across model layers, enabling highly efficient updates.
sentences.zh: 融合框架可以算法化地生成并跨模型层共享，从而实现高效更新。

sentences.en: Only the sparse coefficients of the basis expansion are stored/optimized, strongly reducing the memory footprint and parameter count.
sentences.zh: 仅基展开的稀疏系数被存储/优化，大幅降低了内存占用与参数数量。

sentences.en: The sparse structure of the coefficient matrix in FrameFT and the sparsity in the Fusion Frames, give sizable compute benefits.
sentences.zh: FrameFT 中系数矩阵的稀疏结构以及融合框架中的稀疏性，带来了可观的计算收益。

sentences.en: Our technical analysis shows that FrameFT allows obtaining formal convergence results.
sentences.zh: 我们的技术分析表明，FrameFT 能够获得形式化的收敛结果。

sentences.en: We evaluate our method across a suite of supervised fine-tuning benchmarks, primarily focusing on language tasks, but also report applicability to vision models.
sentences.zh: 我们在多个有监督微调基准上进行评估，主要聚焦于语言任务，同时也报告其对视觉模型的适用性。

sentences.en: Our empirical evaluations show that FrameFT achieves performance on par with or exceeding state-of-the-art PEFT techniques, but needs far fewer trainable parameters and less memory.
sentences.zh: 我们的实证评估表明，FrameFT 在性能上与最先进的 PEFT 技术相当或更优，但所需的可训练参数与内存都少得多。

authors.name: Vikas Singh
authors.institution: University of Wisconsin Madison; Google DeepMind

title_en: Fine-Tuning Without Forgetting In-Context Learning: A Theoretical Analysis of Linear Attention Models
title_zh: 不遗忘上下文学习的微调：线性注意力模型的理论分析

sentences.en: Transformer-based large language models exhibit in-context learning, enabling adaptation to downstream tasks via few-shot prompting with demonstrations.
sentences.zh: 基于 Transformer 的大语言模型展现出上下文学习能力，能够通过带演示的少样本提示适配下游任务。

sentences.en: In practice, such models are often fine-tuned to improve zero-shot performance on downstream tasks, allowing them to solve tasks without examples and thereby reducing inference costs.
sentences.zh: 在实践中，这类模型往往被微调以提升下游任务的零样本性能，使它们无需示例即可解决问题，从而降低推断成本。

sentences.en: However, fine-tuning can degrade in-context learning, limiting the performance of fine-tuned models on tasks not seen during fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 然而，微调可能会损害上下文学习，限制微调后模型在微调期间未见任务上的性能。

sentences.en: Using linear attention models, we provide a theoretical analysis that characterizes how fine-tuning objectives modify attention parameters and identifies conditions under which this leads to degraded few-shot performance.
sentences.zh: 借助线性注意力模型，我们提供一项理论分析，刻画微调目标如何修改注意力参数，并识别在何种条件下这会导致少样本性能的下降。

sentences.en: We show that fine-tuning all attention parameters can harm in-context learning, whereas restricting updates to the value matrix improves zero-shot performance while preserving in-context learning.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，微调所有注意力参数会损害上下文学习，而将更新限制在值矩阵上则能提升零样本性能，同时保持上下文学习能力。

sentences.en: We further show that incorporating an auxiliary few-shot loss enhances in-context learning primarily on the target task, at the expense of degraded in-context learning ability on tasks not seen during fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步表明，纳入一个辅助少样本损失主要能增强目标任务的上下文学习，代价是降低微调期间未见任务上的上下文学习能力。

sentences.en: We provide empirical evidence from synthetic and real-world datasets consistent with the qualitative predictions of our theory.
sentences.zh: 我们提供的来自合成与真实世界数据集的实证证据，与理论定性预测一致。

title_en: Fingerprinting Pre-trained Encoders under Arbitrary Downstream Fine-Tuning via Adversarial Shifting
title_zh: 通过对抗偏移识别任意下游微调后预训练编码器的指纹

sentences.en: In the pre-training-fine-tuning paradigm, pre-trained encoders have become high-value intellectual property (IP) due to their immense training costs, necessitating robust protection.
sentences.zh: 在预训练-微调范式中，预训练编码器因其巨大的训练成本而成为高价值的知识产权（IP），需要稳健的保护。

sentences.en: Existing fingerprinting or watermarking methods typically rely on pre-defined samples and labels, or require intrusive modifications to the training process.
sentences.zh: 现有的指纹或水印方法通常依赖预定义的样本与标签，或需要对训练过程进行侵入式修改。

sentences.en: However, downstream fine-tuning can significantly alter an encoder's representation and label space, thereby destroying the label consistency of existing methods and rendering them ineffective.
sentences.zh: 然而，下游微调会显著改变编码器的表示与标签空间，从而破坏现有方法的标签一致性，使其失效。

sentences.en: Consequently, it is both challenging and urgent to provide a downstream-agnostic, black-box ownership verification mechanism for pre-trained encoders.
sentences.zh: 因此，为预训练编码器提供一种与下游无关、黑盒的所有权验证机制，既具挑战性又十分紧迫。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose a downstream-agnostic, label-only fingerprinting method that leverages Adversarial Shifting to construct stable fingerprint clusters in the encoder’s latent space.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一需求，我们提出一种与下游无关、仅基于标签的指纹方法，它利用对抗性迁移在编码器的潜空间中构建稳定的指纹簇。

sentences.en: By exploiting the inherent output consistency of these clusters, our method remains effective regardless of the specific downstream task or label mapping.
sentences.zh: 通过利用这些簇固有的输出一致性，无论具体的下游任务或标签映射如何，我们的方法都能保持有效。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method maintains superior robustness and stealthiness across various downstream tasks and category scales, providing a practical and reliable IP protection scheme for high-value pre-trained encoders.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，我们的方法在多种下游任务与类别规模下都保持了优越的鲁棒性与隐蔽性，为高价值预训练编码器提供了一种实用且可靠的 IP 保护方案。

title_en: Finite and Corruption-Robust Regret Bounds in Online Inverse Linear Optimization under M-Convex Action Sets
title_zh: M 凸动作集下在线逆线性优化的有限且抗污染遗憾界

sentences.en: We study online inverse linear optimization, also known as contextual recommendation, where a *learner* sequentially infers an *agent*’s hidden objective vector from observed optimal actions over feasible sets that change over time.
sentences.zh: 我们研究在线逆线性优化，也称为上下文推荐，其中 *学习者* 依序从随时间变化的可行集上的观察最优动作中推断 *智能体* 的隐藏目标向量。

sentences.en: The learner aims to recommend actions that perform well under the agent’s true objective, and the performance is measured by the *regret*, defined as the cumulative gap between the agent’s optimal values and those achieved by the learner's recommended actions.
sentences.zh: 学习者的目标是在智能体真实目标下推荐表现良好的动作，性能由 *遗憾* 衡量，定义为智能体最优值与学习者推荐动作所达到值之间的累积差距。

sentences.en: Prior work has established a regret bound of $O(d\log T)$, as well as a finite but exponentially large bound of $\exp(O(d\log d))$, where $d$ is the dimension of the optimization problem and $T$ is the time horizon, while a regret lower bound of $\Omega(d)$ is known (Gollapudi et al. 2021; Sakaue et al. 2025).
sentences.zh: 先前的工作已建立 $O(d\log T)$ 的遗憾界，以及有限但指数级大的 $\exp(O(d\log d))$ 界，其中 $d$ 是优化问题的维度，$T$ 是时域长度；同时已知 $\Omega(d)$ 的遗憾下界（Gollapudi 等人，2021；Sakaue 等人，2025）。

sentences.en: Whether a finite regret bound polynomial in $d$ is achievable or not has remained an open question.
sentences.zh: 关于是否能够达到关于 $d$ 为多项式的有限遗憾界，仍然是一个开放问题。

sentences.en: We partially resolve this by showing that when the feasible sets are *M-convex*—a broad class that includes matroids—a finite regret bound of $O(d\log d)$ is possible.
sentences.zh: 我们部分解决了这一问题：我们表明，当可行集为 *M-凸*（一个包含拟阵在内的广泛类别）时，可以达到 $O(d\log d)$ 的有限遗憾界。

sentences.en: We achieve this by combining a structural characterization of optimal solutions on M-convex sets with a geometric volume argument.
sentences.zh: 我们通过将 M-凸集上最优解的结构刻画与几何体积论证相结合来实现这一点。

sentences.en: Moreover, we extend our approach to adversarially corrupted feedback in up to $C$ rounds.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们将方法扩展到最多 $C$ 轮的对抗性污染反馈。

sentences.en: We obtain a regret bound of $O((C+1)d\log d)$ without prior knowledge of $C$, by monitoring directed graphs induced by the observed feedback to detect corruptions adaptively.
sentences.zh: 我们通过监控观测反馈所诱导的有向图来自适应地检测污染，在无需预先知道 $C$ 的情况下获得了 $O((C+1)d\log d)$ 的遗憾界。

title_en: Finite-time Convergence Analysis of Actor-Critic with Evolving Reward
title_zh: 奖励不断演化时行动者–评论家的有限时间收敛分析

sentences.en: Many popular practical reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms employ evolving reward functions—through techniques such as reward shaping, entropy regularization, or curriculum learning—yet their theoretical foundations remain underdeveloped.
sentences.zh: 许多流行的实际强化学习（RL）算法都采用演化的奖励函数——通过奖励塑形、熵正则化或课程学习等技术——但其理论基础仍未充分发展。

sentences.en: This paper provides the first finite-time convergence analysis of a single-timescale actor-critic algorithm in the presence of an evolving reward function under Markovian sampling.
sentences.zh: 本文提供了在马尔可夫采样下、存在演化奖励函数时，单时间尺度 actor-critic 算法的首个有限时间收敛分析。

sentences.en: We consider a setting where the reward parameters may change at each time step, affecting both policy optimization and value estimation.
sentences.zh: 我们考虑奖励参数每个时间步都可能变化、从而同时影响策略优化与值估计的设定。

sentences.en: Under standard assumptions, we derive non-asymptotic bounds for both actor and critic errors.
sentences.zh: 在标准假设下，我们为 actor 与 critic 的误差推导出非渐近界。

sentences.en: Our result shows that an $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ convergence rate is achievable, matching the best-known rate for static rewards, provided the reward parameters evolve slowly enough.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，只要奖励参数演化得足够慢，就能实现 $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ 的收敛速率，与静态奖励的已知最优速率相匹配。

sentences.en: This rate is preserved when the reward is updated via a gradient-based rule with bounded gradient and on the same timescale as the actor and critic, offering a theoretical foundation for many popular RL techniques.
sentences.zh: 当奖励通过具有有界梯度的基于梯度的规则、并且在与 actor 和 critic 相同的时间尺度上更新时，这一速率得以保持，为许多流行的 RL 技术提供了理论基础。

sentences.en: As a secondary contribution, we introduce a novel analysis of distribution mismatch under Markovian sampling, improving the best-known rate by a factor of $\log^2T$ in the static-reward case.
sentences.zh: 作为次要贡献，我们引入一种马尔可夫采样下分布不匹配的新分析，在静态奖励情形下比已知最优速率提高了 $\log^2T$ 倍。

title_en: Finite-Width Neural Tangent Kernels from Feynman Diagrams
title_zh: 从 Feynman 图推导有限宽度神经切线核

sentences.en: Neural tangent kernels (NTKs) are a powerful tool for analyzing deep, non-linear neural networks.
sentences.zh: 神经正切核（NTK）是分析深层非线性神经网络的有力工具。

sentences.en: In the infinite-width limit, NTKs can easily be computed for most common architectures, yielding full analytic control over the training dynamics.
sentences.zh: 在无限宽度极限下，对于大多数常见架构都能轻松计算 NTK，从而对训练动态获得充分的解析控制。

sentences.en: However, at infinite width, important properties of training such as NTK evolution or feature learning are absent.
sentences.zh: 然而，在无限宽度下，训练的重要性质（如 NTK 演化或特征学习）会缺失。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, finite width effects can be included by computing corrections to the Gaussian statistics at infinite width.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，可以通过计算对无限宽度下高斯统计量的修正来纳入有限宽度效应。

sentences.en: We introduce Feynman diagrams for computing finite-width corrections to NTK statistics.
sentences.zh: 我们引入费曼图来计算 NTK 统计量的有限宽度修正。

sentences.en: These dramatically simplify the necessary algebraic manipulations and enable the computation of layer-wise recursion relations for arbitrary statistics involving preactivations, NTKs and certain higher-derivative tensors (dNTK and ddNTK) required to predict the training dynamics at leading order.
sentences.zh: 这些方法极大地简化了所需的代数运算，并能够为涉及预激活、NTK 以及预测主导阶训练动态所需的某些高阶导数张量（dNTK 与 ddNTK）的任意统计量计算逐层递推关系。

sentences.en: We demonstrate the feasibility of our framework by extending stability results for deep networks from preactivations to NTKs and proving the absence of finite-width corrections for scale-invariant nonlinearities such as ReLU on the diagonal of the Gram matrix of the NTK.
sentences.zh: 我们通过将深层网络的稳定性结果从预激活扩展到 NTK，并证明 ReLU 等尺度不变非线性在 NTK 格拉姆矩阵对角线上不存在有限宽度修正，来展示我们框架的可行性。

sentences.en: We numerically implement the complete set of equations necessary to compute the first-order corrections for arbitrary inputs and demonstrate that the results follow the statistics of sampled neural networks for widths $n\gtrsim 20$.
sentences.zh: 我们以数值方式实现了计算任意输入一阶修正所需的全部方程组，并证明所得结果遵循宽度 $n\gtrsim 20$ 采样神经网络的统计特性。

title_en: FIPN: Forward Self-Organizing Interpretable Polynomial Networks for Time Series Forecasting
title_zh: FIPN：用于时间序列预测的前向自组织可解释多项式网络

sentences.en: Most existing time-series forecasters are trained end-to-end with backpropagation, which often increases computational cost and limits structural transparency.
sentences.zh: 现有多数时间序列预测器都使用反向传播进行端到端训练，这往往会增加计算成本并限制结构透明度。

sentences.en: As a result, it remains difficult to trace how their predictions are formed.
sentences.zh: 其结果是，它们预测的形成过程难以追踪。

sentences.en: This paper presents FIPN, a forward self-organizing interpretable polynomial network for time-series forecasting.
sentences.zh: 本文提出 FIPN，一种用于时间序列预测的前向自组织可解释多项式网络。

sentences.en: FIPN grows its architecture layer by layer through candidate generation, closed-form estimation, and validation-based selection, without relying on backpropagation-based optimization.
sentences.zh: FIPN 通过候选生成、闭式估计与基于验证的选择，逐层生长其架构，而不依赖基于反向传播的优化。

sentences.en: Each neuron couples a fuzzy rule antecedent with a Fourier-enhanced polynomial consequent: fuzzy clustering softly partitions the input space and produces interpretable rule weights for local regimes, while the consequent retains access to original features and uses Fourier functions to capture periodic and frequency-related structures.
sentences.zh: 每个神经元将模糊规则前件与傅里叶增强的多项式后件相结合：模糊聚类软性地划分输入空间，并为局部区域产生可解释的规则权重，而后件保留对原始特征的访问，并利用傅里叶函数捕获周期性与频率相关结构。

sentences.en: Since forward growth may introduce redundancy, collinearity, and overfitting as depth increases, FIPN further incorporates regularized node scoring, dropout-based redundancy control, and persistent access to raw inputs.
sentences.zh: 由于前向生长可能随深度增加而引入冗余、共线性与过拟合，FIPN 进一步整合了正则化的节点评分、基于 dropout 的冗余控制以及对原始输入的持续访问。

sentences.en: Experiments on long-horizon forecasting benchmarks show that FIPN achieves competitive accuracy with a compact model size, while the learned fuzzy rules provide rule- and structure-level explanations.
sentences.zh: 在长时域预测基准上的实验表明，FIPN 以紧凑的模型规模取得了有竞争力的准确率，同时所学到的模糊规则提供了规则级与结构级的解释。

sentences.en: These results suggest that forward self-organizing polynomial networks offer a practical balance among accuracy, efficiency, and interpretability for long-horizon forecasting.
sentences.zh: 这些结果说明，前向自组织多项式网络在长时域预测中提供了准确率、效率与可解释性之间的实用平衡。

title_en: FIRE-Bench: Evaluating AI Agents on the Rediscovery of Scientific Insights
title_zh: FIRE-Bench：评估 AI 智能体重新发现科学洞见的能力

sentences.en: Autonomous AI agents powered by large language models (LLMs) are increasingly capable of running a full cycle of scientific research, yet we still lack reliable ways to verify that their discoveries are correct.
sentences.zh: 由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的自主 AI 智能体越来越有能力运行完整的科学研究闭环，但我们仍然缺乏可靠的方法来验证它们的发现是否正确。

sentences.en: Because novel findings demand costly real-world validation, existing benchmarks fall back on LLM-as-judge scoring of generated papers or single leaderboard metrics, both coarse proxies for scientific reasoning.
sentences.zh: 由于新颖发现需要代价高昂的现实世界验证，现有基准退而采用 LLM 作为评判者对生成论文打分，或采用单一的排行榜指标，这两者都是对科学推理的粗糙替代。

sentences.en: We introduce FIRE-BENCH (Full-cycle Insight Rediscovery Evaluation), which instead asks agents to rediscover established, verifiable findings from recent, high-impact machine learning research.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 FIRE-BENCH（全闭环洞见再发现评估），它反而要求智能体再发现近期高影响力机器学习研究中已确立的、可验证的发现。

sentences.en: Given only a high-level research question from a published study, an agent must independently design experiments, run them, and draw evidence-backed conclusions, scored against the study's documented findings.
sentences.zh: 仅给定已发表研究中的一个高层研究问题，智能体必须独立设计实验、运行实验，并得出有证据支撑的结论，其得分与研究所记载的发现相对照。

sentences.en: Across state-of-the-art agents with frontier backbones such as gpt-5, even the strongest reaches limited rediscovery success (<50 F1), with high run-to-run variance and recurring failures in experimental design, execution, and evidence-based reasoning.
sentences.zh: 在使用 gpt-5 等前沿骨干能力的各最先进智能体中，即使最强的智能体也只能达到有限的再发现成功率（F1 < 50），且存在很高的运行间方差，在实验设计、执行与基于证据的推理方面反复失败。

sentences.en: Beyond diagnosing current systems, FIRE-BENCH shows that open-ended discovery can be evaluated rigorously and verifiably, laying a foundation for building reliable environments that improve agents.
sentences.zh: 除了诊断当前系统之外，FIRE-BENCH 还表明，开放式发现可以严格且可验证地进行评估，为构建能够提升智能体的可靠环境奠定了基础。

title_en: FiRE: Fine-grained Ranking Evaluation for Machine Translation
title_zh: FiRE：机器翻译的细粒度排序评估

sentences.en: Developing reliable machine translation (MT) systems hinges on our ability to distinguish superior translations from inferior ones.
sentences.zh: 开发可靠的机器翻译（MT）系统，关键在于我们区分更优翻译与较差翻译的能力。

sentences.en: However, existing evaluation paradigms, whether limited to coarse overall rankings or misaligned with human preferences, fail to deliver interpretable, fine‑grained feedback in reference‑free settings.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的评估范式——无论是局限于粗略的整体排名，还是与人类偏好不一致——都无法在无参考环境中提供可解释、细粒度的反馈。

sentences.en: We present a Fine-Grained Ranking Evaluation method (FiRE) that leverages off‑the‑shelf large language models to perform criterion‑driven pairwise comparison across three complementary dimensions: faithfulness, fluency, and consistency of style, instead of producing a single holistic judgment.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一种细粒度排名评估方法（FiRE），它利用现成的大语言模型，在忠实度、流畅性与风格一致性三个互补维度上进行基于准则的两两比较，而不是给出单一的整体判断。

sentences.en: To enable rigorous meta‑evaluation of evaluation paradigms in the absence of any suitable testbed, we construct the first human‑annotated, reference‑free benchmark for fine-grained ranking evaluation, achieving substantial inter‑annotator agreement.
sentences.zh: 为在缺乏合适测试台的情况下实现评估范式的严格元评估，我们构建了首个含人工标注、无参考的细粒度排名评估基准，达成了显著的标注者间一致性。

sentences.en: Through meta‑evaluation on this benchmark and existing MQM datasets, FiRE demonstrably outperforms regression‑based and error‑analysis metrics in aligning with human comparative judgments, while providing more informative insights into translation quality.
sentences.zh: 通过在该基准与现有 MQM 数据集上的元评估，FiRE 在与人比较判断对齐方面明显优于基于回归的指标与错误分析指标，并为翻译质量提供了更具信息量的洞见。

sentences.en: Finally, our examination of LLM evaluator biases (position and self-enhancement) and their handling of tied cases offers guidance for more nuanced MT evaluation.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们考察了 LLM 评估者的偏差（位置与自我增强）及其对平局情形的处理，为更细致入微的 MT 评估提供了指导。

sentences.en: Code and benchmark resources are available at https://github.com/wygao8/FiRE-MT.
sentences.zh: 代码与基准资源可在 https://github.com/wygao8/FiRE-MT 获取。

authors.name: Jing Li
authors.institution: Sichuan Lan-bridge Information Technology Co., Ltd.

title_en: FIRE: Learning to Navigate and Act on Real-World Files via Stateful Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: FIRE：通过有状态强化学习学习浏览和操作真实世界文件

sentences.en: Large language models still struggle to reliably answer questions grounded in real-world files like spreadsheets and slides, where evidence is scattered across irregular layouts and heterogeneous formats.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型在可靠地回答以现实世界文件（如电子表格与幻灯片）为依据的问题方面仍然困难重重，因为这些文件中的证据散布在非规整的布局与异构格式之间。

sentences.en: We address this by formalizing File Reasoning, a setting where agents must interact directly with unprocessed files (XLSX, PDF, DOCX, PPTX) within a persistent sandbox.
sentences.zh: 我们通过形式化文件推理来应对这一挑战，在这一设定中，智能体必须在持久沙箱内直接与未处理的文件（XLSX、PDF、DOCX、PPTX）交互。

sentences.en: To support this, we introduce a unified data pipeline and a high-difficulty benchmark of over 400 verifiable questions that preserve native file structure.
sentences.zh: 为支持这一点，我们引入一个统一的数据流水线，以及一个包含 400 多个可验证问题、保留原生文件结构的高难度基准。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we propose a reinforcement learning framework grounded in stateful file execution.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们提出一个以有状态文件执行为基础的强化学习框架。

sentences.en: We train **FIRE** (**F**ile **I**nteractive **R**easoning **E**xpert), a family of models that learn to optimize long-horizon planning using genuine execution feedback.
sentences.zh: 我们训练 **FIRE**（**File** **I**nteractive **R**easoning **E**xpert），一组学会利用真实执行反馈来优化长时域规划的模型。

sentences.en: Unlike stateless tool-use methods, this environmental persistence enables agents to iteratively recover from errors and adapt to structural ambiguities.
sentences.zh: 与无状态工具使用方法不同，这种环境的持久性使智能体能够迭代地从错误中恢复，并适应结构歧义。

sentences.en: Empirical results show that Qwen3-32B-FIRE achieves the strongest performance among the open-source models of comparable scale under identical execution constraints.
sentences.zh: 实证结果表明，在相同的执行约束下，Qwen3-32B-FIRE 在规模相当的各类开源模型中取得了最强的性能。

title_en: FIRE: Multi-fidelity Regression with Distribution-conditioned In-context Learning using Tabular Foundation Models
title_zh: FIRE：利用表格基础模型与分布条件上下文学习进行多保真度回归

sentences.en: Multi-fidelity (MF) regression often operates in regimes of extreme data imbalance, where the commonly-used Gaussian-process surrogates struggle with cubic scaling costs and overfit to sparse high-fidelity observations, limiting efficiency and generalization in real-world applications.
sentences.zh: 多保真度（MF）回归往往在极端数据不均衡的机制下运行，此时常用的高斯过程代理模型难以应对立方级扩展成本，并会过拟合稀疏的高保真度观测，从而限制了现实世界应用中的效率与泛化。

sentences.en: We introduce FIRE, a training-free MF framework that couples tabular foundation models (TFMs) to perform zero-shot in-context Bayesian inference via a high-fidelity correction model conditioned on the low-fidelity model's posterior predictive distributions.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 FIRE，一个免训练的 MF 框架，它将表格基础模型（TFM）耦合，通过一个以低保真度模型的后验预测分布为条件的高保真度校正模型，执行零样本上下文贝叶斯推断。

sentences.en: This cross-fidelity information transfer via distributional summaries captures heteroscedastic errors, enabling robust residual learning without model retraining.
sentences.zh: 这种通过分布摘要进行的跨保真度信息迁移捕获了异方差误差，使得无需模型重新训练即可实现稳健的残差学习。

sentences.en: Across 31 benchmark problems spanning synthetic functions and real-world tasks (e.g., DrivAerNet, LCBench), FIRE delivers a stronger performance–time trade-off than seven state-of-the-art GP-based or deep learning MF regression methods, ranking highest in accuracy and uncertainty quantification with runtime advantages.
sentences.zh: 在跨越合成函数与现实世界任务（如 DrivAerNet、LCBench）的 31 个基准问题上，FIRE 提供了比七种最先进的基于 GP 或深度学习的 MF 回归方法更强的性能-时间权衡，在准确率与不确定性量化上排名最高，同时具备运行时优势。

sentences.en: Limitations include context window constraints and dependence on the quality of the pre-trained TFM’s.
sentences.zh: 局限包括上下文窗口约束以及对预训练 TFM 质量的依赖。

title_en: FiSeR: Fine-Grained Source Representations for Cross-Domain AI Image Detection
title_zh: FiSeR：跨域 AI 图像检测的细粒度来源表征

sentences.en: Real-world synthetic image detectors often generalize poorly under domain shift despite strong in-domain performance.
sentences.zh: 现实世界的合成图像检测器在域偏移下往往泛化不佳，尽管域内性能强劲。

sentences.en: Using unsupervised UMAP projections, we find that natural and synthetic features remain partially separable on unseen datasets, yet performance still drops, suggesting that the classification head overfits to training-domain artifacts.
sentences.zh: 利用无监督的 UMAP 投影，我们发现自然与合成特征在未见数据集上仍然部分可分离，但性能仍然下降，这表明分类头对训练域的伪影过度拟合。

sentences.en: Therefore, the key is to learn more transferable representations so that the decision criterion is more stable and robust to domain shifts.
sentences.zh: 因此，关键在于学习更具可迁移性的表示，使决策准则更稳定、对域偏移更鲁棒。

sentences.en: Based on the structural fact that synthetic images are produced by diverse generators, we propose a hierarchical contrastive learning framework that improves the separability between natural and synthetic images while preserving generator identity information.
sentences.zh: 基于合成图像由多种生成器产生的结构性事实，我们提出一个分层对比学习框架，在保持生成器身份信息的同时提高自然图像与合成图像之间的可分离性。

sentences.en: It jointly optimizes (i) a coarse contrastive objective between natural and synthetic images and (ii) a fine contrastive objective among synthetic images using generator identities.
sentences.zh: 它联合优化 (i) 自然与合成图像之间的粗粒度对比目标，以及 (ii) 利用生成器身份的合成图像之间的细粒度对比目标。

sentences.en: Trained on WildFake, our method achieves an average AUROC gain of +10.22 on cross-domain evaluation over Chameleon, AIGIBench, Community Forensics, and GenImage under the same settings as the strong baseline DIRE.
sentences.zh: 在 WildFake 上训练后，我们的方法在与强基线 DIRE 相同的设置下，跨域评估（包括 Chameleon、AIGIBench、Community Forensics 和 GenImage）的平均 AUROC 提升达到 +10.22。

sentences.en: For few-shot adaptation, we freeze the backbone and fit an SVM head on 10 labeled samples per class, improving AUROC by +10.64 on AIGIBench and +17.41 on Chameleon, averaged over 12 widely used detectors.
sentences.zh: 对于少样本适配，我们冻结骨干网络，并在每类 10 个标注样本上拟合 SVM 头，在 12 个广泛使用的检测器上平均，AIGIBench 的 AUROC 提升 +10.64，Chameleon 提升 +17.41。

sentences.en: Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/heyongxin233/FiSeR.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码已在 https://github.com/heyongxin233/FiSeR 公开发布。

title_en: Fisher-Preserving Guidance: Training-Free Manifold Constraints for Safe Diffusion Control
title_zh: Fisher 保持引导：用于安全扩散控制的无需训练流形约束

sentences.en: Diffusion models are effective for waypoint prediction in visual navigation, but standard sampling and test time guidance can produce unreliable or inefficient trajectories when updates drift off the training manifold.
sentences.zh: 扩散模型对视觉导航中的航点预测是有效的，但当更新偏离训练流形时，标准采样与测试时引导可能产生不可靠或低效的轨迹。

sentences.en: We propose Fisher Preserving Guidance with Outer Product Span Projection, a training-free inference method that avoids large Fisher drift associated with off-distribution actions while optimizing a task objective.
sentences.zh: 我们提出带外积跨度投影的 Fisher 保持引导，一种免训练的推断方法，它在优化任务目标的同时避免与分布外动作相关的较大 Fisher 漂移。

sentences.en: Our method computes the Fisher-preserving update via a low-rank Jacobian factorization, requiring only a single backward pass per step and enabling real-time use.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法通过低秩雅可比因子分解计算 Fisher 保持更新，每步仅需一次反向传播，从而支持实时使用。

sentences.en: We further introduce Truncated Fisher Denoising Sensitivity as an uncertainty signal and use it for robust multi-sample action blending.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步引入截断 Fisher 去噪灵敏度作为不确定性信号，并将其用于稳健的多样本动作混合。

sentences.en: Experiments on toy and realistic navigation benchmarks, including Maze2D with TSDF-based guidance, PushT with official Diffusion Policy weights, and visual navigation in simulation and on real robots, demonstrate consistent improvements in performance over strong diffusion-policy baselines without additional training.
sentences.zh: 在玩具与真实导航基准上的实验，包括基于 TSDF 引导的 Maze2D、使用官方 Diffusion Policy 权重的 PushT，以及在仿真和真实机器人上的视觉导航，都表明在无需额外训练的情况下，相对强扩散策略基线的性能有一致的提升。

title_en: Fix Before Search: Benchmarking Agentic Visual Query Pre-processing in Multimodal Retrieval-augmented Generation
title_zh: 先修复再搜索：评测多模态检索增强生成中的智能体式视觉查询预处理

sentences.en: Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MRAG) has emerged as a key paradigm for grounding MLLMs with external knowledge.
sentences.zh: 多模态检索增强生成（MRAG）已成为用外部知识支撑 MLLM 的关键范式。

sentences.en: While query pre-processing (e.g., rewriting) is standard in text-based RAG, existing MRAG pipelines predominantly treat visual inputs as static and immutable, implicitly assuming they are noise-free.
sentences.zh: 虽然查询预处理（如重写）在基于文本的 RAG 中是标准做法，但现有的 MRAG 流水线主要将视觉输入视为静态且不可变的，隐含地假设它们无噪声。

sentences.en: However, real-world visual queries are often ``imperfect''---suffering from geometric distortions, quality degradation, or semantic ambiguity---leading to catastrophic retrieval failures.
sentences.zh: 然而，现实世界的视觉查询往往是“不完美的”——遭受几何畸变、质量退化或语义歧义——从而导致灾难性的检索失败。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we propose V-QPP-Bench, the first comprehensive benchmark dedicated to Visual Query Pre-processing (V-QPP).
sentences.zh: 为填补这一空白，我们提出 V-QPP-Bench，第一个专用于视觉查询预处理（V-QPP）的全面基准。

sentences.en: We formulate V-QPP as an agentic decision-making task where MLLMs must autonomously diagnose imperfections and deploy perceptual tools to refine queries.
sentences.zh: 我们将 V-QPP 构建为一项智能体决策任务，其中 MLLM 必须自主诊断不完美之处，并部署感知工具来精炼查询。

sentences.en: Our extensive evaluation across 46,700 imperfect queries and diverse MRAG paradigms reveals three critical insights: (1) Vulnerability---visual imperfections severely degrade both retrieval recall and end-to-end MRAG performance;
sentences.zh: 我们在 46,700 个不完美查询与多种 MRAG 范式上的全面评估揭示了三个关键洞见：(1) 脆弱性——视觉不完美之处严重损害检索召回率与端到端 MRAG 性能；(2) 恢复潜力与瓶颈——虽然预言机预处理能恢复近乎完美的性能，但现成的 MLLM 在未经过专门训练的情况下难以进行工具选择与参数预测；以及 (3) 训练增强——监督微调使紧凑模型能够达到与更大专有模型相当或更优的性能，证明该基准对开发稳健 MRAG 系统的价值。

sentences.en: (2) Restoration Potential \& Bottleneck---while oracle preprocessing recovers near-perfect performance, off-the-shelf MLLMs struggle with tool selection and parameter prediction without specialized training; and (3) Training Enhancement---supervised fine-tuning enables compact models to achieve comparable or superior performance to larger proprietary models, demonstrating the benchmark's value for developing robust MRAG systems The code is available at https://github.com/phycholosogy/VQQP_Bench
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/phycholosogy/VQQP_Bench 获取。
